57 static bool isPtrInAddrSpace(mlir::Value ptr, NVVMMemorySpace targetAS) {
58  auto ptrTy = llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(ptr.getType());
59  return ptrTy.getAddressSpace() == static_cast<unsigned>(targetAS);
60 }

74 static llvm::Value *castPtrToAddrSpace(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
75  llvm::Value *ptr,

82 // Helper method to convert CtaGroupKind in NVVM Dialect to CtaGroupKind in LLVM
83 static llvm::nvvm::CTAGroupKind
84 getNVVMCtaGroupKind(NVVM::CTAGroupKind ctaGroup) {
85  switch (ctaGroup) {
86  case NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_1:
87  return llvm::nvvm::CTAGroupKind::CG_1;
88  case NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_2:
89  return llvm::nvvm::CTAGroupKind::CG_2;
90  }
91  llvm_unreachable("unsupported cta_group value");
92 }

94 static ParseResult parseCTAGroup(OpAsmParser &parser,
95  NVVM::CTAGroupKindAttr &groupAttr) {
96  StringRef keyword;
97  if (parser.parseKeyword(&keyword))
98  return failure();
99  std::optional<NVVM::CTAGroupKind> group =
100  NVVM::symbolizeCTAGroupKind(keyword);
101  if (!group)
102  return parser.emitError(parser.getNameLoc()) << " expected CTA group";
103  groupAttr = NVVM::CTAGroupKindAttr::get(parser.getContext(), *group);
104  return success();
105 }
106 
107 static void printCTAGroup(OpAsmPrinter &printer, Operation *,
108  NVVM::CTAGroupKindAttr groupAttr) {
109  printer << NVVM::stringifyCTAGroupKind(groupAttr.getValue());
110 }
111 
112 template <typename AttrTy>
113 static ParseResult parseEnumKeyword(OpAsmParser &parser, AttrTy &attr) {
114  SMLoc loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
115  std::string keyword;
116  if (parser.parseKeywordOrString(&keyword))
117  return failure();
118 
119  using EnumTy = decltype(attr.getValue());
120  std::optional<EnumTy> value = NVVM::symbolizeEnum<EnumTy>(keyword);
121  if (!value)
122  return parser.emitError(loc) << "unknown enum value '" << keyword << "'";
123 
124  attr = AttrTy::get(parser.getContext(), *value);
125  return success();
126 }

132 // This verifier is shared among the following Ops:
133 // CpAsyncBulkTensorSharedCTAToGlobalOp (TMA Store)
134 // CpAsyncBulkTensorReduceOp (TMA Store-Reduce)
135 static LogicalResult cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(size_t tensorDims,
136  bool isIm2Col,
137  size_t numIm2ColOffsets,
138  Location loc) {
139  if (tensorDims < 1 || tensorDims > 5)
140  return emitError(loc, "expects coordinates between 1 to 5 dimension");
141 
142  // For Im2Col mode, there are two constraints:
143  if (isIm2Col) {
144  // 1. Tensor must always be at least 3-d.
145  if (tensorDims < 3)
146  return emitError(
147  loc,
148  "to use im2col mode, the tensor has to be at least 3-dimensional");
149  // 2. When there are Im2ColOffsets, they must be (Dims - 2) in number.
150  if (numIm2ColOffsets && (tensorDims != (numIm2ColOffsets + 2)))
151  return emitError(
152  loc, "im2col offsets must be 2 less than number of coordinates");
153  }
154  return success();
155 }
156 
157 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorOverrideAddrCommonVerifier(
158  OperandRange coordinates, OperandRange tensorSize, OperandRange lowerStride,
159  Value upperStride, bool isTile, Location loc) {
160  LogicalResult res = success();
161  if (!tensorSize.empty() && coordinates.size() != tensorSize.size()) {
162  res =
163  emitError(loc, "Expected coordinates size to be equal to tensor size");
164  }
165 
166  if (!lowerStride.empty() && tensorSize.empty()) {
167  res = emitError(
168  loc,
169  "Expected tensor_size to be present when lower_stride is provided");
170  } else if (!lowerStride.empty() &&
171  lowerStride.size() != tensorSize.size() - 1) {
172  res = emitError(
173  loc,
174  "Expected lower_stride size to be equal to one less than tensor size");
175  }
176 
177  if (!lowerStride.empty() != static_cast<bool>(upperStride)) {
178  res = emitError(loc,
179  "Expected lower_stride and upper_stride to be either both "
180  "present or both absent");
181  }
182 
183  bool isDimStride = tensorSize.size() > 0;
184  if (!isTile && isDimStride) {
185  res = emitError(
186  loc, "Only tile mode supports override address with dim and stride");
187  }
188 
189  return res;
190 }

192 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorSharedCTAToGlobalOp::verify() {
193  TMAStoreMode mode = getMode();
194  // We lower through inline-ptx when getPredicate() is true.
195  // a) Only TILE mode is supported
196  // b) Cache-hint is not supported
197  if (getPredicate()) {
198  if (mode != TMAStoreMode::TILE)
199  return emitError("Inline-ptx lowering supported only for Tile mode.");
200  if (getL2CacheHint())
201  return emitError("Inline-ptx lowering unsupported with L2 cache-hint.");
202  }
203 
204  size_t dims = getCoordinates().size();
205  switch (mode) {
206  case TMAStoreMode::TILE:
207  return cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(dims, false, 0, getLoc());
208  case TMAStoreMode::IM2COL:
209  case TMAStoreMode::IM2COL_W:
210  return cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(dims, true, 0, getLoc());
211  case TMAStoreMode::TILE_SCATTER4:
212  if (dims != 5)
213  return emitError("Scatter4 mode expects 5 coordinates");
214  }
215  return success();
216 }
217 
218 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorSharedCTAToGlobalOverrideAddrOp::verify() {
219  TMAStoreMode mode = getMode();
220  bool isIm2Col =
221  mode == TMAStoreMode::IM2COL || mode == TMAStoreMode::IM2COL_W;
222  bool isTile = mode == TMAStoreMode::TILE;
223 
224  LogicalResult commonRes = cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(
225  getCoordinates().size(), isIm2Col, 0, getLoc());
226 
227  LogicalResult overrideAddrRes = CpAsyncBulkTensorOverrideAddrCommonVerifier(
228  getCoordinates(), getTensorSize(), getLowerStride(), getUpperStride(),
229  isTile, getLoc());
230 
231  if (mode == TMAStoreMode::TILE_SCATTER4 && getCoordinates().size() != 5)
232  overrideAddrRes = emitError("Mode tile scatter4 expects 5 coordinates");
233 
234  return failed(commonRes) || failed(overrideAddrRes) ? failure() : success();
235 }

237 LogicalResult CpAsyncOp::verify() {
238  if (getModifier() != LoadCacheModifierKind::CG &&
239  getModifier() != LoadCacheModifierKind::CA)
240  return emitError("Only CG and CA cache modifiers are supported.");
241  if (getSize() != 4 && getSize() != 8 && getSize() != 16)
242  return emitError("expected byte size to be either 4, 8 or 16.");
243  if (getModifier() == LoadCacheModifierKind::CG && getSize() != 16)
244  return emitError("CG cache modifier is only support for 16 bytes copy.");
245  return success();
246 }

248 // This verify params can be shared across TMA Load and Prefetch Ops.
249 static LogicalResult verifyTMALoadParams(size_t tensorDims, size_t numIm2colOff,
250  TMALoadMode mode, Location loc) {
251  if (tensorDims < 1 || tensorDims > 5)
252  return emitError(loc, "expects coordinates between 1 to 5 dimension");
253 
254  auto checkTMALoadParams = [&](TMALoadMode mode, bool isIm2col,
255  size_t expectedIm2colOff) -> LogicalResult {
256  if (isIm2col && (tensorDims < 3))
257  return emitError(loc)
258  << "to use " << mode
259  << " mode, the tensor has to be at least 3-dimensional";
260 
261  if (numIm2colOff != expectedIm2colOff)
262  return emitError(loc) << " im2col offsets expected " << expectedIm2colOff
263  << " (provided " << numIm2colOff << ")";
264 
265  return success();
266  };
267 
268  switch (mode) {
269  case TMALoadMode::TILE:
270  return checkTMALoadParams(mode, false, 0);
271  case TMALoadMode::IM2COL:
272  return checkTMALoadParams(mode, true, tensorDims - 2);
273  case TMALoadMode::IM2COL_W:
274  case TMALoadMode::IM2COL_W_128:
275  return checkTMALoadParams(mode, true, 2);
276  case TMALoadMode::TILE_GATHER4:
277  return (tensorDims == 5)
278  ? checkTMALoadParams(mode, false, 0)
279  : emitError(loc, "Gather4 mode expects 5 coordinates");
280  }
281  return success();
282 }

284 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorPrefetchOp::verify() {
285  return verifyTMALoadParams(getCoordinates().size(), getIm2colOffsets().size(),
286  getMode(), getLoc());

289 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorGlobalToSharedClusterOp::verify() {
290  TMALoadMode mode = getMode();
291  bool isCTAOnly = getIsCTAOnly();
292  if (getPredicate()) { // Inline-asm based lowering
293  if (isCTAOnly)
294  return emitError("Predicate is supported only for shared::cluster mode.");
295  if (mode != TMALoadMode::TILE && mode != TMALoadMode::IM2COL)
296  return emitError(
297  "Predicate is supported only for Tile and Im2col modes.");
298  } else { // Intrinsics-based lowering
299  NVVMMemorySpace expectedAS =
300  isCTAOnly ? NVVMMemorySpace::Shared : NVVMMemorySpace::SharedCluster;
301  unsigned AS = llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(getDstMem().getType())
302  .getAddressSpace();
303  if (AS != expectedAS)
304  return emitError()
305  << (isCTAOnly
306  ? "Shared::cta destination requires address-space 3."
307  : "Shared::cluster destination requires address-space 7.");
308  // Checks specific to shared::cta mode
309  if (isCTAOnly) {
310  if (getMulticastMask())
311  return emitError("Multicast is not supported with shared::cta mode.");
312  if (getGroup())
313  return emitError("CTAGroup is not supported with shared::cta mode.");
314  }
315  }
316 
317  return verifyTMALoadParams(getCoordinates().size(), getIm2colOffsets().size(),
318  getMode(), getLoc());
319 }

321 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorReduceOp::verify() {
322  TMAStoreMode mode = getMode();
323  size_t dims = getCoordinates().size();
324  switch (mode) {
325  case TMAStoreMode::TILE:
326  return cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(dims, false, 0, getLoc());
327  case TMAStoreMode::IM2COL:
328  case TMAStoreMode::IM2COL_W:
329  return cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(dims, true, 0, getLoc());
330  case TMAStoreMode::TILE_SCATTER4:
331  return emitError("Scatter mode unsupported for CpAsyncBulkTensorReduceOp");
332  }
333  return success();
334 }

336 LogicalResult CpAsyncBulkTensorReduceOverrideAddrOp::verify() {
337  bool isIm2Col =
338  getMode() == TMAStoreMode::IM2COL || getMode() == TMAStoreMode::IM2COL_W;
339  bool isTile = getMode() == TMAStoreMode::TILE;
340 
341  LogicalResult commonRes = cpAsyncBulkTensorCommonVerifier(
342  getCoordinates().size(), isIm2Col, 0, getLoc());
343 
344  LogicalResult overrideAddrRes = CpAsyncBulkTensorOverrideAddrCommonVerifier(
345  getCoordinates(), getTensorSize(), getLowerStride(), getUpperStride(),

351 
352  return failed(commonRes) || failed(overrideAddrRes) ? failure() : success();

363 static LogicalResult verifyMBarrierArriveLikeOp(Operation *op, Value addr,
364  NVVM::MemScopeKind scope,
365  Value retVal = nullptr) {
366  if (scope != NVVM::MemScopeKind::CTA && scope != NVVM::MemScopeKind::CLUSTER)
367  return op->emitError("mbarrier scope must be either CTA or Cluster");
368 
369  bool isSharedCluster = isPtrInSharedClusterSpace(addr);
370  bool hasRetValue = static_cast<bool>(retVal);
371  if (isSharedCluster && hasRetValue)
372  return op->emitError(
373  "mbarrier in shared_cluster space cannot return any value");
374 
375  return success();
376 }

388 LogicalResult MBarrierArriveExpectTxOp::verify() {
389  // The inline-ptx version of this Op does not support all features.
390  // With predicate, this Op lowers to inline-ptx. So, verify and
391  // error-out if there are unsupported features.
392  if (getPredicate()) {
393  if (getScope() != NVVM::MemScopeKind::CTA)
394  return emitError("mbarrier scope must be CTA when using predicate");
395 
396  if (isPtrInSharedClusterSpace(getAddr()))
397  return emitError("mbarrier in shared_cluster space is not supported when "
398  "using predicate");
399 
400  if (getRes())
401  return emitError("return-value is not supported when using predicate");
402 
403  if (getRelaxed() == true)
404  return emitError("mbarrier with relaxed semantics is not supported when "
405  "using predicate");
406  }
407  return verifyMBarrierArriveLikeOp(getOperation(), getAddr(), getScope(),
408  getRes());
409 }

417 // inferReturnTypes for mbarrier arrive-like ops

420 /// Only shared_cluster (ptr<7>) produces zero results; all other address
421 /// spaces (including generic) return i64.
422 static LogicalResult
423 inferMBarrierArriveResultTypes(MLIRContext *context, Value addr,
424  SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
425  if (!isPtrInSharedClusterSpace(addr))
426  inferredReturnTypes.push_back(IntegerType::get(context, 64));
427  return success();
428 }

467 /// For ops with optional results, allow the user to omit the result even when
468 /// inference would produce one. This preserves backward compatibility: the
469 /// result can be silently discarded (e.g., for fire-and-forget arrive ops).
470 static bool isCompatibleReturnTypesOptionalResult(TypeRange inferred,
471  TypeRange actual) {
472  if (actual.empty())
473  return true;
474  return inferred == actual;
475 }
476

508 LogicalResult ConvertFloatToTF32Op::verify() {
509  using RndMode = NVVM::FPRoundingMode;
510  switch (getRnd()) {
511  case RndMode::RNA:
512  if (getRelu())
513  return emitError("Relu not supported with rna rounding mode.");
514  break;
515  case RndMode::RN:
516  case RndMode::RZ:
517  break;
518  default:
519  return emitError(
520  "Only {rn,rz,rna} rounding modes supported for ConvertFloatToTF32Op.");
521  }
522  return success();
523 }

525 LogicalResult ConvertF32x2ToF6x2Op::verify() {

529  return emitOpError("Only ")

532  << " types are supported for conversions from f32x2 to f6x2.";

537 LogicalResult ConvertF32x2ToF8x2Op::verify() {
538  using RndMode = NVVM::FPRoundingMode;
539  using SatMode = NVVM::SaturationMode;
540 
541  bool isRoundingModeRN = getRnd() == RndMode::RN;
542  bool isRoundingModeRZ = getRnd() == RndMode::RZ;
543  bool isRoundingModeRP = getRnd() == RndMode::RP;
544  bool isSatFinite = getSat() == SatMode::SATFINITE;
545 
546  bool hasRelu = getRelu();
547 
548  mlir::MLIRContext *ctx = getContext();
549 
550  return llvm::TypeSwitch<mlir::Type, LogicalResult>(getDstTy())
551  .Case<mlir::Float8E4M3FNType, mlir::Float8E5M2Type>(
552  [&](mlir::Type) -> LogicalResult {
553  if (!isRoundingModeRN) {
554  return emitOpError("Only RN rounding mode is supported for "
555  "conversions from f32x2 to ")
556  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << " and "
557  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx) << " types";
558  }
559  if (!isSatFinite) {
560  return emitOpError("Only SATFINITE saturation mode is supported "
561  "for conversions "
562  "from f32x2 to ")
563  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << " and "
564  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx) << " types";
565  }
566  return success();
567  })
568  .Case<mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType>([&](mlir::Type) -> LogicalResult {
569  if (!(isRoundingModeRZ || isRoundingModeRP)) {
570  return emitOpError("Only RZ and RP rounding modes are supported for "
571  "conversions from f32x2 to ")
572  << mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType::get(ctx) << " type";
573  }
574  if (hasRelu) {
575  return emitOpError("relu not supported for conversions to ")
576  << mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType::get(ctx) << " type";
577  }
578  return success();
579  })
580  .Default([&](mlir::Type) {
581  return emitOpError("Only ")
582  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << ", "
583  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx) << ", and "
584  << mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType::get(ctx)
585  << " types are "
586  "supported for conversions from f32x2 to f8x2";
587  });
588 }
589 
590 LogicalResult ConvertF16x2ToF8x2Op::verify() {
591  mlir::MLIRContext *ctx = getContext();
592 
593  if (!llvm::isa<mlir::Float8E4M3FNType, mlir::Float8E5M2Type>(getDstTy())) {
594  return emitOpError("Only ")
595  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << " and "
596  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx)
597  << " types are supported for conversions from f16x2 to f8x2.";
598  }
599  return success();
600 }
601 
602 LogicalResult ConvertBF16x2ToF8x2Op::verify() {
603  using RndMode = NVVM::FPRoundingMode;
604  using SatMode = NVVM::SaturationMode;
605 
606  bool isRoundingModeRN = getRnd() == RndMode::RN;
607  bool isRoundingModeRZ = getRnd() == RndMode::RZ;
608  bool isRoundingModeRP = getRnd() == RndMode::RP;
609  bool isSatFinite = getSat() == SatMode::SATFINITE;
610  bool hasRelu = getRelu();
611 
612  mlir::MLIRContext *ctx = getContext();
613 
614  return llvm::TypeSwitch<mlir::Type, LogicalResult>(getDstTy())
615  .Case<mlir::Float8E4M3FNType, mlir::Float8E5M2Type>(
616  [&](mlir::Type) -> LogicalResult {
617  if (!isRoundingModeRN)
618  return emitOpError("Only RN rounding mode is supported for "
619  "conversions from bf16x2 to ")
620  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << " and "
621  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx) << " types";
622  if (!isSatFinite)
623  return emitOpError("Only SATFINITE saturation mode is supported "
624  "for conversions from bf16x2 to ")
625  << mlir::Float8E4M3FNType::get(ctx) << " and "
626  << mlir::Float8E5M2Type::get(ctx) << " types";
627  return success();
628  })
629  .Case<mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType>([&](mlir::Type) -> LogicalResult {
630  if (!(isRoundingModeRZ || isRoundingModeRP))
631  return emitOpError("Only RZ and RP rounding modes are supported for "
632  "conversions from bf16x2 to ")
633  << mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType::get(ctx) << " type";
634  if (hasRelu)
635  return emitOpError("relu not supported for conversions to ")
636  << mlir::Float8E8M0FNUType::get(ctx) << " type";
637  return success();
638  })
639  .Default([&](mlir::Type) -> LogicalResult {
640  llvm_unreachable("Invalid conversion in ConvertBF16x2ToF8x2Op");
641  return failure();
642  });
643 }
644

674 LogicalResult PermuteOp::verify() {
675  using Mode = NVVM::PermuteMode;
676  bool hasHi = static_cast<bool>(getHi());
677 
678  switch (getMode()) {
679  case Mode::DEFAULT:
680  case Mode::F4E:
681  case Mode::B4E:
682  if (!hasHi)
683  return emitError("mode '") << getMode() << "' requires 'hi' operand.";
684  break;
685  case Mode::RC8:
686  case Mode::ECL:
687  case Mode::ECR:
688  case Mode::RC16:
689  if (hasHi)
690  return emitError("mode '")
691  << getMode() << "' does not accept 'hi' operand.";
692  break;
693  }
694 
695  return success();
696 }

702 static LogicalResult verifyConvertF32x2ToFP16x2Op(Twine dstType,
703  FPRoundingMode rnd,
704  bool hasRandomBits,
705  Operation *op) {
706  static constexpr FPRoundingMode validRndModes[] = {
707  FPRoundingMode::RN, FPRoundingMode::RZ, FPRoundingMode::RS};
708 
709  if (!llvm::is_contained(validRndModes, rnd)) {
710  return op->emitOpError(
711  "Only RN, RZ, and RS rounding modes are supported for "
712  "conversions from f32x2 to ")
713  << dstType << ".";
714  }
715 
716  if (rnd == FPRoundingMode::RS) {
717  if (!hasRandomBits) {
718  return op->emitOpError("random_bits is required for RS rounding mode.");
719  }
720  } else {
721  if (hasRandomBits) {
722  return op->emitOpError(
723  "random_bits not supported for RN and RZ rounding modes.");
724  }
725  }
726 
727  return success();
728 }

798 LogicalResult PMEventOp::verify() {
799  auto eventId = getEventId();
800  auto maskedEventId = getMaskedEventId();
801  if (!maskedEventId && !eventId) {
802  return emitOpError() << "either `id` or `mask` must be set";
803  }
804 
805  if (maskedEventId && eventId) {
806  return emitOpError() << "`id` and `mask` cannot be set at the same time";
807  }
808 
809  if (eventId) {
810  if (eventId < 0 || eventId > 15) {
811  return emitOpError() << "`id` must be between 0 and 15";
812  }
813  }
814 
815  return llvm::success();
816 }

818 // Given the element type of an operand and whether or not it is an accumulator,
819 // this function returns the PTX type (`NVVM::MMATypes`) that corresponds to the
820 // operand's element type.
821 std::optional<mlir::NVVM::MMATypes>
822 MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(Type operandElType, bool isAccumulator) {
823  auto half2Type =
824  VectorType::get(2, Float16Type::get(operandElType.getContext()));
825  if (operandElType.isF64())
826  return NVVM::MMATypes::f64;
827  if (operandElType.isF16() || operandElType == half2Type)
828  return NVVM::MMATypes::f16;
829  if (operandElType.isF32() && isAccumulator)
830  return NVVM::MMATypes::f32;
831  if (operandElType.isF32() && !isAccumulator)
832  return NVVM::MMATypes::tf32;
833  if (llvm::isa<IntegerType>(operandElType)) {
834  if (isAccumulator)
835  return NVVM::MMATypes::s32;
836  return std::nullopt;
837  }
838 
839  if (auto structType = llvm::dyn_cast<LLVM::LLVMStructType>(operandElType)) {
840  if (structType.getBody().empty())
841  return std::nullopt;
842  return inferOperandMMAType(structType.getBody()[0], isAccumulator);
843  }
844 
845  return std::nullopt;
846 }
847 
848 static bool isInt4PtxType(MMATypes type) {
849  return (type == MMATypes::u4 || type == MMATypes::s4);
850 }
851 
852 static bool isInt8PtxType(MMATypes type) {
853  return (type == MMATypes::u8 || type == MMATypes::s8);
854 }
855 
856 static bool isIntegerPtxType(MMATypes type) {
857  return isInt4PtxType(type) || isInt8PtxType(type) || type == MMATypes::b1 ||
858  type == MMATypes::s32;
859 }
860 
861 MMATypes MmaOp::accumPtxType() {
862  std::optional<mlir::NVVM::MMATypes> val = inferOperandMMAType(
863  getODSOperands(2).getTypes().front(), /*isAccumulator=*/true);
864  assert(val.has_value() && "accumulator PTX type should always be inferrable");
865  return val.value();
866 }
867 
868 MMATypes MmaOp::resultPtxType() {
869  std::optional<mlir::NVVM::MMATypes> val =
870  inferOperandMMAType(getResult().getType(), /*isAccumulator=*/true);
871  assert(val.has_value() && "result PTX type should always be inferrable");
872  return val.value();
873 }

875 template <typename AttrTy>
876 static void printMmaProperty(OpAsmPrinter &printer, bool &isFirst,
877  StringRef keyword, AttrTy value) {

879  printer.printStrippedAttrOrType(value);

883 template <typename AttrTy>

891 static void printMmaUnitProperty(OpAsmPrinter &printer, bool &isFirst,
892  StringRef keyword) {

896 
897 template <typename AttrTy>
898 static ParseResult parseMmaPropertyValue(OpAsmParser &parser,
899  NamedAttrList &attributes,
900  StringRef name) {
901  if (attributes.get(name))
902  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
903  "duplicate property '" + name + "'");
904  AttrTy value;
905  if (parser.parseEqual() || parser.parseCustomAttributeWithFallback(value))
906  return failure();
907  attributes.append(name, value);
908  return success();
909 }
910 
911 template <typename AttrTy>
912 static ParseResult parseMmaEnumPropertyValue(OpAsmParser &parser,
913  NamedAttrList &attributes,
914  StringRef name) {
915  if (attributes.get(name))
916  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
917  "duplicate property '" + name + "'");
918  AttrTy value;
919  if (parser.parseEqual() || parseEnumKeyword(parser, value))
920  return failure();
921  attributes.append(name, value);
922  return success();
923 }
924 
925 static bool isMmaPropertyName(StringRef name) {
926  return llvm::is_contained(
927  ArrayRef<StringRef>{
928  "shape", "b1Op", "intOverflowBehavior", "layoutA", "layoutB",
929  "multiplicandAPtxType", "multiplicandBPtxType", "orderedMetadata",
930  "kind", "scaleVecSize", "blockScaleFormat", "operandSegmentSizes"},
931  name);
932 }
933 
934 static ParseResult parseMmaProperties(OpAsmParser &parser,
935  NamedAttrList &attributes,
936  ArrayRef<StringRef> allowedKeywords,
937  ArrayRef<StringRef> requiredProperties) {
938  while (true) {
939  StringRef keyword;
940  if (parser.parseKeyword(&keyword))
941  return failure();
942  if (!llvm::is_contained(allowedKeywords, keyword))
943  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
944  "unknown MMA property '" + keyword + "'");
945 
946  ParseResult parseResult = success();
947  if (keyword == "shape")
948  parseResult =
949  parseMmaPropertyValue<MMAShapeAttr>(parser, attributes, "shape");
950  else if (keyword == "b1_op")
951  parseResult =
952  parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMAB1OpAttr>(parser, attributes, "b1Op");
953  else if (keyword == "int_overflow")
954  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMAIntOverflowAttr>(
955  parser, attributes, "intOverflowBehavior");
956  else if (keyword == "layout_a")
957  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMALayoutAttr>(parser, attributes,
958  "layoutA");
959  else if (keyword == "layout_b")
960  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMALayoutAttr>(parser, attributes,
961  "layoutB");
962  else if (keyword == "multiplicand_a_ptx_type")
963  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMATypesAttr>(
964  parser, attributes, "multiplicandAPtxType");
965  else if (keyword == "multiplicand_b_ptx_type")
966  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMATypesAttr>(
967  parser, attributes, "multiplicandBPtxType");
968  else if (keyword == "kind") {
969  if (llvm::is_contained(allowedKeywords, "block_scale_format"))
970  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMABlockScaleKindAttr>(
971  parser, attributes, "kind");
972  else
973  parseResult =
974  parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<MMAKindAttr>(parser, attributes, "kind");
975  } else if (keyword == "scale_vec_size")
976  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<ScaleVecSizeAttr>(
977  parser, attributes, "scaleVecSize");
978  else if (keyword == "block_scale_format")
979  parseResult = parseMmaEnumPropertyValue<BlockScaleFormatAttr>(
980  parser, attributes, "blockScaleFormat");
981  else if (keyword == "ordered_metadata") {
982  if (attributes.get("orderedMetadata"))
983  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
984  "duplicate property 'orderedMetadata'");
985  attributes.append("orderedMetadata", parser.getBuilder().getUnitAttr());
986  } else {
987  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
988  "unknown MMA property '" + keyword + "'");
989  }
990  if (failed(parseResult))
991  return failure();
992  if (failed(parser.parseOptionalComma()))
993  break;
994  }
995 
996  for (StringRef property : requiredProperties) {
997  if (!attributes.get(property))
998  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
999  "missing required property '" + property + "'");
1000  }
1001 
1002  NamedAttrList discardableAttributes;
1003  if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(discardableAttributes))
1004  return failure();
1005  for (NamedAttribute attribute : discardableAttributes) {
1006  if (isMmaPropertyName(attribute.getName()))
1007  return parser.emitError(
1008  parser.getCurrentLocation(),
1009  "inherent property '" + attribute.getName().getValue() +
1010  "' must be spelled directly in the operation syntax");
1011  attributes.append(attribute);
1012  }
1013  return success();
1014 }
1015 
1016 void MmaOp::print(OpAsmPrinter &p) {
1017  SmallVector<Type, 4> regTypes;
1018  struct MMAOperandFragment {
1019  StringRef operandName;
1020  StringRef ptxTypeAttr;
1021  SmallVector<Value, 4> regs;
1022  explicit MMAOperandFragment(StringRef name, StringRef ptxTypeName)
1023  : operandName(name), ptxTypeAttr(ptxTypeName) {}
1024  };
1025 
1026  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 3> frags{
1027  MMAOperandFragment("A", getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()),
1028  MMAOperandFragment("B", getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()),
1029  MMAOperandFragment("C", "")};
1030  SmallVector<StringRef, 4> ignoreAttrNames{
1031  mlir::NVVM::MmaOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr()};
1032 
1033  for (unsigned fragIdx = 0; fragIdx < frags.size(); fragIdx++) {
1034  auto &frag = frags[fragIdx];
1035  auto varOperandSpec = getODSOperandIndexAndLength(fragIdx);
1036  for (auto operandIdx = varOperandSpec.first;
1037  operandIdx < varOperandSpec.first + varOperandSpec.second;
1038  operandIdx++) {
1039  frag.regs.push_back(this->getOperand(operandIdx));
1040  if (operandIdx == 0) {
1041  regTypes.push_back(this->getOperand(operandIdx).getType());
1042  }
1043  }
1044  std::optional<MMATypes> inferredType = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(
1045  regTypes.back(), /*isAccumulator=*/fragIdx >= 2);
1046  if (inferredType)
1047  ignoreAttrNames.push_back(frag.ptxTypeAttr);
1048  }
1049 
1050  auto printMmaOperand = [&](const MMAOperandFragment &frag) -> void {
1051  p << " " << frag.operandName;
1052  p << "[";
1053  p.printOperands(frag.regs);
1054  p << "] ";
1055  };
1056 
1057  for (const auto &frag : frags) {
1058  printMmaOperand(frag);
1059  }
1060 
1061  bool isFirstProperty = true;
1062  printMmaProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "shape", getShapeAttr());
1063  if (getB1OpAttr())
1064  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "b1_op", getB1OpAttr());
1065  if (getIntOverflowBehaviorAttr())
1066  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "int_overflow",
1067  getIntOverflowBehaviorAttr());
1068  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "layout_a", getLayoutAAttr());
1069  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "layout_b", getLayoutBAttr());
1070  if (getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr() &&
1071  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()))
1072  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
1073  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr());
1074  if (getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr() &&
1075  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()))
1076  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_b_ptx_type",
1077  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr());
1078  llvm::append_range(ignoreAttrNames,
1079  ArrayRef<StringRef>{getShapeAttrName(), getB1OpAttrName(),
1080  getIntOverflowBehaviorAttrName(),
1081  getLayoutAAttrName(),
1082  getLayoutBAttrName(),
1083  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName(),
1084  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()});
1085  p.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getDiscardableAttrDictionary().getValue(),
1086  ignoreAttrNames);
1087 
1088  // Print the types of the operands and result.
1089  p << " : " << "(";
1090  llvm::interleaveComma(SmallVector<Type, 3>{frags[0].regs[0].getType(),
1091  frags[1].regs[0].getType(),
1092  frags[2].regs[0].getType()},
1093  p);
1094  p << ")";
1095  p.printArrowTypeList(TypeRange{this->getRes().getType()});
1096 }
1097 
1098 void MmaOp::build(OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &result, Type resultType,
1099  ValueRange operandA, ValueRange operandB, ValueRange operandC,
1100  ArrayRef<int64_t> shape, std::optional<MMAB1Op> b1Op,
1101  std::optional<MMAIntOverflow> intOverflow,
1102  std::optional<std::array<MMATypes, 2>> multiplicandPtxTypes,
1103  std::optional<std::array<MMALayout, 2>> multiplicandLayouts) {
1104 
1105  assert(shape.size() == 3 && "expected shape to have size 3 (m, n, k)");
1106  MLIRContext *ctx = builder.getContext();
1107  result.addAttribute(
1108  "shape", builder.getAttr<MMAShapeAttr>(shape[0], shape[1], shape[2]));
1109 
1110  result.addOperands(operandA);
1111  result.addOperands(operandB);
1112  result.addOperands(operandC);
1113 
1114  if (multiplicandPtxTypes) {
1115  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType",
1116  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[0]));
1117  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType",
1118  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[1]));
1119  } else {
1120  if (auto res = inferOperandMMAType(operandA[0].getType(), false))
1121  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
1122  if (auto res = inferOperandMMAType(operandB[0].getType(), false))
1123  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
1124  }
1125 
1126  if (multiplicandLayouts) {
1127  result.addAttribute("layoutA",
1128  MMALayoutAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandLayouts)[0]));
1129  result.addAttribute("layoutB",
1130  MMALayoutAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandLayouts)[1]));
1131  } else {
1132  result.addAttribute("layoutA", MMALayoutAttr::get(ctx, MMALayout::row));
1133  result.addAttribute("layoutB", MMALayoutAttr::get(ctx, MMALayout::col));
1134  }
1135 
1136  if (intOverflow.has_value())
1137  result.addAttribute("intOverflowBehavior",
1138  MMAIntOverflowAttr::get(ctx, *intOverflow));
1139  if (b1Op.has_value())
1140  result.addAttribute("b1Op", MMAB1OpAttr::get(ctx, *b1Op));
1141 
1142  result.addTypes(resultType);
1143  result.addAttribute(
1144  MmaOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr(),
1145  builder.getDenseI32ArrayAttr({static_cast<int32_t>(operandA.size()),
1146  static_cast<int32_t>(operandB.size()),
1147  static_cast<int32_t>(operandC.size())}));
1148 }
1149 
1150 // <operation> :=
1151 // A `[` $operandA `]` B `[` $operandB `]` C `[` $operandC `]`
1152 // properties attr-dict
1153 // : (type($operandA[0]), type($operandB[0]), type($operandC[0]))
1154 // `->` type($res)
1155 ParseResult MmaOp::parse(OpAsmParser &parser, OperationState &result) {
1156  struct MMAOperandFragment {
1157  std::optional<MMATypes> elemtype;
1158  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 4> regs;
1159  SmallVector<Type> regTypes;
1160  };
1161 
1162  Builder &builder = parser.getBuilder();
1163  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 4> frags;
1164 
1165  NamedAttrList namedAttributes;
1166 
1167  // A helper to parse the operand segments.
1168  auto parseMmaOperand = [&](StringRef operandName,
1169  MMAOperandFragment &frag) -> LogicalResult {
1170  if (parser.parseKeyword(operandName).failed())
1171  return failure();
1172  if (parser
1173  .parseOperandList(frag.regs, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::OptionalSquare)
1174  .failed())
1175  return failure();
1176  return success();
1177  };
1178 
1179  // Parse the operand segments.
1180  if (parseMmaOperand("A", frags[0]).failed())
1181  return failure();
1182  if (parseMmaOperand("B", frags[1]).failed())
1183  return failure();
1184  if (parseMmaOperand("C", frags[2]).failed())
1185  return failure();
1186 
1187  if (parseMmaProperties(parser, namedAttributes,
1188  {"shape", "b1_op", "int_overflow", "layout_a",
1189  "layout_b", "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
1190  "multiplicand_b_ptx_type"},
1191  {"shape", "layoutA", "layoutB"}))
1192  return failure();
1193 
1194  // Parse the type specification and resolve operands.
1195  SmallVector<Type, 3> operandTypes;
1196  if (failed(parser.parseColon()))
1197  return failure();
1198  if (failed(parser.parseLParen()))
1199  return failure();
1200  if (failed(parser.parseTypeList(operandTypes)))
1201  return failure();
1202  if (failed(parser.parseRParen()))
1203  if (operandTypes.size() != 3)
1204  return parser.emitError(
1205  parser.getNameLoc(),
1206  "expected one type for each operand segment but got " +
1207  Twine(operandTypes.size()) + " types");
1208  for (const auto &iter : llvm::enumerate(operandTypes)) {
1209  auto &frag = frags[iter.index()];
1210  frag.regTypes.resize(frag.regs.size(), iter.value());
1211  if (failed(parser.resolveOperands(frag.regs, frag.regTypes,
1212  parser.getNameLoc(), result.operands)))
1213  return failure();
1214  frag.elemtype = inferOperandMMAType(frag.regTypes[0],
1215  /*isAccumulator*/ iter.index() < 2);
1216  }
1217 
1218  Type resultType;
1219  if (parser.parseArrow() || parser.parseType(resultType))
1220  return failure();
1221  frags[3].elemtype = inferOperandMMAType(resultType, /*isAccumulator*/ true);
1222 
1223  std::array<StringRef, 2> names{"multiplicandAPtxType",
1224  "multiplicandBPtxType"};
1225  for (unsigned idx = 0; idx < names.size(); idx++) {
1226  const auto &frag = frags[idx];
1227  std::optional<NamedAttribute> attr = namedAttributes.getNamed(names[idx]);
1228  if (!frag.elemtype.has_value() && !attr.has_value()) {
1229  return parser.emitError(
1230  parser.getNameLoc(),
1231  "attribute " + names[idx] +
1232  " is not provided explicitly and cannot be inferred");
1233  }
1234  if (!attr.has_value())
1235  result.addAttribute(
1236  names[idx], MMATypesAttr::get(parser.getContext(), *frag.elemtype));
1237  }
1238 
1239  result.addTypes(resultType);
1240  if (!namedAttributes.empty())
1241  result.addAttributes(namedAttributes);
1242  result.addAttribute(MmaOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr(),
1243  builder.getDenseI32ArrayAttr({
1244  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[0].regs.size()),
1245  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[1].regs.size()),
1246  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[2].regs.size()),
1247  }));
1248  return success();
1249 }
1250 
1251 LogicalResult MmaOp::verify() {
1252  MLIRContext *context = getContext();
1253  auto f16Ty = Float16Type::get(context);
1254  auto i32Ty = IntegerType::get(context, 32);
1255  auto f16x2Ty = VectorType::get(2, f16Ty);
1256  auto f32Ty = Float32Type::get(context);
1257  auto f16x2x4StructTy = LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1258  context, {f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty});
1259 
1260  auto s32x4StructTy =
1261  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {i32Ty, i32Ty, i32Ty, i32Ty});
1262  auto f32x8StructTy =
1263  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, SmallVector<Type>(8, f32Ty));
1264  auto f16x2x2StructTy =
1265  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty});
1266  auto f32x4StructTy =
1267  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty});
1268  auto s32x2StructTy =
1269  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {i32Ty, i32Ty});
1270 
1271  std::array<int64_t, 3> mmaShape{getShapeAttr().getM(), getShapeAttr().getN(),
1272  getShapeAttr().getK()};
1273 
1274  // These variables define the set of allowed data types for matrices A, B, C,
1275  // and result.
1276  using AllowedShapes = SmallVector<std::array<int64_t, 3>, 2>;
1277  using AllowedTypes = SmallVector<SmallVector<Type, 4>, 2>;
1278  AllowedShapes allowedShapes;
1279  AllowedTypes expectedA;
1280  AllowedTypes expectedB;
1281  AllowedTypes expectedC;
1282  SmallVector<Type> expectedResult;
1283 
1284  // When M = 16, we just need to calculate the number of 8xk tiles, where
1285  // k is a factor that depends on the data type.
1286  if (mmaShape[0] == 16) {
1287  int64_t kFactor;
1288  Type multiplicandFragType;
1289  switch (*getMultiplicandAPtxType()) {
1290  case MMATypes::tf32:
1291  kFactor = 4;
1292  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1293  expectedResult.push_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1294  context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty}));
1295  break;
1296  case MMATypes::bf16:
1297  kFactor = 8;
1298  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1299  expectedResult.push_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1300  context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty}));
1301  break;
1302  case MMATypes::f16:
1303  kFactor = 8;
1304  multiplicandFragType = f16x2Ty;
1305  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x2StructTy);
1306  expectedResult.push_back(f32x4StructTy);
1307  break;
1308  case MMATypes::e4m3:
1309  case MMATypes::e5m2:
1310  // FP8 (m16n8k16 / m16n8k32) packs 4 values per 32-bit register, same
1311  // as s8/u8, but the accumulator is f16 or f32 (not integer).
1312  kFactor = 16;
1313  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1314  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x2StructTy);
1315  expectedResult.push_back(f32x4StructTy);
1316  break;
1317  case MMATypes::s4:
1318  case MMATypes::u4:
1319  kFactor = 32;
1320  break;
1321  case MMATypes::b1:
1322  kFactor = 128;
1323  break;
1324  case MMATypes::s8:
1325  case MMATypes::u8:
1326  kFactor = 16;
1327  break;
1328  default:
1329  return emitError("invalid shape or multiplicand type: ")
1330  << getMultiplicandAPtxType().value();
1331  }
1332 
1333  if (isIntegerPtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value())) {
1334  expectedResult.push_back(s32x4StructTy);
1335  expectedC.emplace_back(4, i32Ty);
1336  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1337  } else {
1338  expectedC.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1339  expectedC.emplace_back(4, f32Ty);
1340  }
1341 
1342  int64_t unitA = (mmaShape[0] / 8) * (mmaShape[2] / kFactor);
1343  int64_t unitB = (mmaShape[1] / 8) * (mmaShape[2] / kFactor);
1344  expectedA.emplace_back(unitA, multiplicandFragType);
1345  expectedB.emplace_back(unitB, multiplicandFragType);
1346  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, kFactor});
1347  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, kFactor * 2});
1348 
1349  if (resultPtxType() != accumPtxType())
1350  return emitOpError("ctype does not match dtype");
1351  }
1352 
1353  // In the M=8 case, there is only 1 possible case per data type.
1354  if (mmaShape[0] == 8) {
1355  if (*getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::f16) {
1356  expectedA.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1357  expectedB.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1358  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x4StructTy);
1359  expectedResult.push_back(f32x8StructTy);
1360  expectedC.emplace_back(4, f16x2Ty);
1361  expectedC.emplace_back(8, f32Ty);
1362  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 4});
1363  }
1364  if (*getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::f64) {
1365  Type f64Ty = Float64Type::get(context);
1366  expectedA.emplace_back(1, f64Ty);
1367  expectedB.emplace_back(1, f64Ty);
1368  expectedC.emplace_back(2, f64Ty);
1369  expectedResult.emplace_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1370  context, SmallVector<Type>(2, f64Ty)));
1371  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 4});
1372  }
1373  if (isIntegerPtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value())) {
1374  expectedA.push_back({i32Ty});
1375  expectedB.push_back({i32Ty});
1376  expectedC.push_back({i32Ty, i32Ty});
1377  expectedResult.push_back(s32x2StructTy);
1378  if (isInt4PtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value()))
1379  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 32});
1380  if (isInt8PtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value()))
1381  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 16});
1382  if (getMultiplicandAPtxType().value() == MMATypes::b1)
1383  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 128});
1384  }
1385  }
1386 
1387  std::string errorMessage;
1388  llvm::raw_string_ostream errorStream(errorMessage);
1389 
1390  // Check that we matched an existing shape/dtype combination.
1391  if (expectedA.empty() || expectedB.empty() || expectedC.empty() ||
1392  !llvm::is_contained(allowedShapes, mmaShape)) {
1393  errorStream << "unimplemented variant for MMA shape <";
1394  llvm::interleaveComma(mmaShape, errorStream);
1395  errorStream << ">";
1396  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1397  }
1398 
1399  // Verify the operand types for segments of A, B, and C operands.
1400  std::array<StringRef, 3> operandNames{"A", "B", "C"};
1401  for (const auto &iter : llvm::enumerate(
1402  SmallVector<AllowedTypes, 3>{expectedA, expectedB, expectedC})) {
1403  auto spec = this->getODSOperandIndexAndLength(iter.index());
1404  SmallVector<Type, 4> operandTySeg(operand_type_begin() + spec.first,
1405  operand_type_begin() + spec.first +
1406  spec.second);
1407  bool match = llvm::is_contained(iter.value(), operandTySeg);
1408 
1409  if (!match) {
1410  errorStream << "Could not match types for the "
1411  << operandNames[iter.index()]
1412  << " operands; expected one of ";
1413  for (const auto &x : iter.value()) {
1414  errorStream << x.size() << "x" << x[0] << " ";
1415  }
1416  errorStream << "but got ";
1417  llvm::interleaveComma(operandTySeg, errorStream);
1418  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1419  }
1420  }
1421 
1422  // Check the result type
1423  if (!llvm::any_of(expectedResult, [&](Type expectedResultType) {
1424  return expectedResultType == getResult().getType();
1425  })) {
1426  errorStream
1427  << "Could not match allowed types for the result; expected one of ";
1428  llvm::interleaveComma(expectedResult, errorStream);
1429  errorStream << " but got " << getResult().getType();
1430  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1431  }
1432 
1433  // Ensure that binary MMA variants have a b1 MMA operation defined.
1434  if (getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::b1 && !getB1Op()) {
1435  return emitOpError("op requires " + getB1OpAttrName().strref() +
1436  " attribute");
1437  }
1438 
1439  // Ensure int4/int8 MMA variants specify the accum overflow behavior
1440  // attribute.
1441  if (isInt4PtxType(*getMultiplicandAPtxType()) ||
1442  isInt8PtxType(*getMultiplicandAPtxType())) {
1443  if (!getIntOverflowBehavior())
1444  return emitOpError("op requires " +
1445  getIntOverflowBehaviorAttrName().strref() +
1446  " attribute");
1447  }
1448 
1449  // Validate layout combinations. According to the operation description, most
1450  // MMA operations require layoutA=row and layoutB=col. Only m8n8k4 with f16
1451  // can use other layout combinations.
1452  bool isM8N8K4_F16 =
1453  (mmaShape[0] == 8 && mmaShape[1] == 8 && mmaShape[2] == 4 &&
1454  getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::f16);
1455 
1456  if (!isM8N8K4_F16) {
1457  // For all other shapes/types, layoutA must be row and layoutB must be col
1458  if (getLayoutA() != MMALayout::row || getLayoutB() != MMALayout::col) {
1459  return emitOpError("requires layoutA = #nvvm.mma_layout<row> and "
1460  "layoutB = #nvvm.mma_layout<col> for shape <")
1461  << mmaShape[0] << ", " << mmaShape[1] << ", " << mmaShape[2]
1462  << "> with element types " << *getMultiplicandAPtxType() << " and "
1463  << *getMultiplicandBPtxType()
1464  << ". Only m8n8k4 with f16 supports other layouts.";
1465  }
1466  }
1467 
1468  return success();
1469 }
1470 
1471 MMATypes MmaSpOp::accumPtxType() {
1472  std::optional<mlir::NVVM::MMATypes> val = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(
1473  getODSOperands(2).getTypes().front(), /*isAccumulator=*/true);
1474  assert(val.has_value() && "accumulator PTX type should always be inferrable");
1475  return val.value();
1476 }
1477 
1478 MMATypes MmaSpOp::resultPtxType() {
1479  std::optional<mlir::NVVM::MMATypes> val =
1480  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(getResult().getType(), /*isAccumulator=*/true);
1481  assert(val.has_value() && "result PTX type should always be inferrable");
1482  return val.value();
1483 }

1485 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
1486 MmaSpOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
1487  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
1488  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::MmaSpOp>(op);
1489 
1490  // Get operands
1491  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
1492  for (mlir::Value v : thisOp.getOperands())
1493  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(v));
1494 
1495  // Get intrinsic ID using the existing getIntrinsicID method
1496  auto intId = MmaSpOp::getIntrinsicID(
1497  thisOp.getShape().getM(), thisOp.getShape().getN(),
1498  thisOp.getShape().getK(), thisOp.getIntOverflowBehavior(),
1499  thisOp.getOrderedMetadata(), thisOp.getKind(),
1500  *thisOp.getMultiplicandAPtxType(), *thisOp.getMultiplicandBPtxType(),
1501  thisOp.accumPtxType(), thisOp.resultPtxType());
1502 
1503  return {intId, args};
1504 }
1505 
1506 void MmaSpOp::print(OpAsmPrinter &p) {
1507  SmallVector<Type, 4> regTypes;
1508  struct MMAOperandFragment {
1509  StringRef operandName;
1510  StringRef ptxTypeAttr;
1511  SmallVector<Value, 4> regs;
1512  explicit MMAOperandFragment(StringRef name, StringRef ptxTypeName)
1513  : operandName(name), ptxTypeAttr(ptxTypeName) {}
1514  };
1515 
1516  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 5> frags{
1517  MMAOperandFragment("A", getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()),
1518  MMAOperandFragment("B", getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()),
1519  MMAOperandFragment("C", ""), MMAOperandFragment("sparseMetadata", ""),
1520  MMAOperandFragment("selector", "")};
1521  SmallVector<StringRef, 4> ignoreAttrNames{
1522  mlir::NVVM::MmaSpOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr()};
1523 
1524  // Handle variadic operands A, B, C
1525  for (unsigned fragIdx = 0; fragIdx < 3; fragIdx++) {
1526  auto &frag = frags[fragIdx];
1527  auto varOperandSpec = getODSOperandIndexAndLength(fragIdx);
1528  for (auto operandIdx = varOperandSpec.first;
1529  operandIdx < varOperandSpec.first + varOperandSpec.second;
1530  operandIdx++) {
1531  frag.regs.push_back(this->getOperand(operandIdx));
1532  if (operandIdx == varOperandSpec.first) {
1533  regTypes.push_back(this->getOperand(operandIdx).getType());
1534  }
1535  }
1536  std::optional<MMATypes> inferredType = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(
1537  regTypes.back(), /*isAccumulator=*/fragIdx >= 2);
1538  if (inferredType)
1539  ignoreAttrNames.push_back(frag.ptxTypeAttr);
1540  }
1541 
1542  // Handle sparse metadata and selector (single operands)
1543  frags[3].regs.push_back(getSparseMetadata());
1544  frags[4].regs.push_back(getSparsitySelector());
1545 
1546  auto printMmaSpOperand = [&](const MMAOperandFragment &frag) -> void {
1547  p << " " << frag.operandName;
1548  p << "[";
1549  p.printOperands(frag.regs);
1550  p << "]";
1551  };
1552 
1553  for (const auto &frag : frags)
1554  printMmaSpOperand(frag);
1555 
1556  bool isFirstProperty = true;
1557  printMmaProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "shape", getShapeAttr());
1558  if (getIntOverflowBehaviorAttr())
1559  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "int_overflow",
1560  getIntOverflowBehaviorAttr());
1561  if (getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr() &&
1562  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()))
1563  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
1564  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr());
1565  if (getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr() &&
1566  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()))
1567  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_b_ptx_type",
1568  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr());
1569  if (getOrderedMetadata())
1570  printMmaUnitProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "ordered_metadata");
1571  if (getKindAttr())
1572  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "kind", getKindAttr());
1573  llvm::append_range(
1574  ignoreAttrNames,
1575  ArrayRef<StringRef>{getShapeAttrName(), getIntOverflowBehaviorAttrName(),
1576  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName(),
1577  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName(),
1578  getOrderedMetadataAttrName(), getKindAttrName()});
1579  p.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getDiscardableAttrDictionary().getValue(),
1580  ignoreAttrNames);
1581  p << " : ";
1582  p << "(";
1583  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
1584  p << regTypes[i];
1585  if (i < 2)
1586  p << ", ";
1587  }
1588  p << ") -> " << getResult().getType();
1589 }
1590 
1591 void MmaSpOp::build(
1592  OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &result, Type resultType,
1593  ValueRange operandA, ValueRange operandB, ValueRange operandC,
1594  Value sparseMetadata, Value sparsitySelector, ArrayRef<int64_t> shape,
1595  std::optional<MMAIntOverflow> intOverflow,
1596  std::optional<std::array<MMATypes, 2>> multiplicandPtxTypes) {
1597 
1598  assert(shape.size() == 3 && "expected shape to have size 3 (m, n, k)");
1599  MLIRContext *ctx = builder.getContext();
1600  result.addAttribute(
1601  "shape", builder.getAttr<MMAShapeAttr>(shape[0], shape[1], shape[2]));
1602 
1603  result.addOperands(operandA);
1604  result.addOperands(operandB);
1605  result.addOperands(operandC);
1606  result.addOperands(sparseMetadata);
1607  result.addOperands(sparsitySelector);
1608 
1609  if (multiplicandPtxTypes) {
1610  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType",
1611  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[0]));
1612  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType",
1613  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[1]));
1614  } else {
1615  if (auto res = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandA[0].getType(), false))
1616  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
1617  if (auto res = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandB[0].getType(), false))
1618  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
1619  }
1620 
1621  if (intOverflow.has_value())
1622  result.addAttribute("intOverflowBehavior",
1623  MMAIntOverflowAttr::get(ctx, *intOverflow));
1624 
1625  result.addTypes(resultType);
1626  result.addAttribute(
1627  MmaSpOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr(),
1628  builder.getDenseI32ArrayAttr({static_cast<int32_t>(operandA.size()),
1629  static_cast<int32_t>(operandB.size()),
1630  static_cast<int32_t>(operandC.size()), 1,
1631  1})); // sparseMetadata and sparsitySelector
1632 }
1633 
1634 ParseResult MmaSpOp::parse(OpAsmParser &parser, OperationState &result) {
1635  struct MMAOperandFragment {
1636  std::optional<MMATypes> elemtype;
1637  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 4> regs;
1638  SmallVector<Type> regTypes;
1639  };
1640 
1641  Builder &builder = parser.getBuilder();
1642  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 6> frags; // A, B, C, sparseMetadata, selector
1643 
1644  NamedAttrList namedAttributes;
1645 
1646  // A helper to parse the operand segments.
1647  auto parseMmaSpOperand = [&](StringRef operandName,
1648  MMAOperandFragment &frag) -> LogicalResult {
1649  if (parser.parseKeyword(operandName).failed())
1650  return failure();
1651  if (parser
1652  .parseOperandList(frag.regs, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::OptionalSquare)
1653  .failed())
1654  return failure();
1655  return success();
1656  };
1657 
1658  // Parse the operand segments.
1659  if (parseMmaSpOperand("A", frags[0]).failed())
1660  return failure();
1661  if (parseMmaSpOperand("B", frags[1]).failed())
1662  return failure();
1663  if (parseMmaSpOperand("C", frags[2]).failed())
1664  return failure();
1665  if (parseMmaSpOperand("sparseMetadata", frags[3]).failed())
1666  return failure();
1667  if (parseMmaSpOperand("selector", frags[4]).failed())
1668  return failure();
1669 
1670  if (parseMmaProperties(parser, namedAttributes,
1671  {"shape", "int_overflow", "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
1672  "multiplicand_b_ptx_type", "ordered_metadata",
1673  "kind"},
1674  {"shape"}))
1675  return failure();
1676 
1677  // Parse the type specification and resolve operands.
1678  SmallVector<Type, 3> operandTypes;
1679  if (failed(parser.parseColon()))
1680  return failure();
1681  if (failed(parser.parseLParen()))
1682  return failure();
1683  if (failed(parser.parseTypeList(operandTypes)))
1684  return failure();
1685  if (failed(parser.parseRParen()))
1686  return failure();
1687  if (operandTypes.size() != 3)
1688  return parser.emitError(
1689  parser.getNameLoc(),
1690  "expected one type for each operand segment but got " +
1691  Twine(operandTypes.size()) + " types");
1692  for (const auto &iter : llvm::enumerate(operandTypes)) {
1693  auto &frag = frags[iter.index()];
1694  frag.regTypes.resize(frag.regs.size(), iter.value());
1695  if (failed(parser.resolveOperands(frag.regs, frag.regTypes,
1696  parser.getNameLoc(), result.operands)))
1697  return failure();
1698  frag.elemtype =
1699  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(frag.regTypes[0],
1700  /*isAccumulator*/ iter.index() >= 2);
1701  }
1702 
1703  Type resultType;
1704  if (parser.parseArrow() || parser.parseType(resultType))
1705  return failure();
1706  frags[5].elemtype =
1707  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(resultType, /*isAccumulator*/ true);
1708 
1709  // Resolve sparse metadata and selector (assume i32 type)
1710  Type i32Type = builder.getIntegerType(32);
1711  if (parser
1712  .resolveOperands(frags[3].regs, i32Type, parser.getCurrentLocation(),
1713  result.operands)
1714  .failed())
1715  return failure();
1716  if (parser
1717  .resolveOperands(frags[4].regs, i32Type, parser.getCurrentLocation(),
1718  result.operands)
1719  .failed())
1720  return failure();
1721 
1722  std::array<StringRef, 2> names{"multiplicandAPtxType",
1723  "multiplicandBPtxType"};
1724  for (unsigned idx = 0; idx < names.size(); idx++) {
1725  const auto &frag = frags[idx];
1726  std::optional<NamedAttribute> attr = namedAttributes.getNamed(names[idx]);
1727  if (!frag.elemtype.has_value() && !attr.has_value()) {
1728  return parser.emitError(
1729  parser.getNameLoc(),
1730  "attribute " + names[idx] +
1731  " is not provided explicitly and cannot be inferred");
1732  }
1733  if (!attr.has_value())
1734  result.addAttribute(
1735  names[idx], MMATypesAttr::get(parser.getContext(), *frag.elemtype));
1736  }
1737 
1738  result.addTypes(resultType);
1739  if (!namedAttributes.empty())
1740  result.addAttributes(namedAttributes);
1741  result.addAttribute(MmaSpOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr(),
1742  builder.getDenseI32ArrayAttr({
1743  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[0].regs.size()),
1744  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[1].regs.size()),
1745  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[2].regs.size()),
1746  1, // sparseMetadata
1747  1 // sparsitySelector
1748  }));
1749  return success();
1750 }
1751 
1752 LogicalResult MmaSpOp::verify() {
1753  MLIRContext *context = getContext();
1754  auto f16Ty = Float16Type::get(context);
1755  auto i32Ty = IntegerType::get(context, 32);
1756  auto f16x2Ty = VectorType::get(2, f16Ty);
1757  auto f32Ty = Float32Type::get(context);
1758  auto f16x2x4StructTy = LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1759  context, {f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty});
1760 
1761  auto s32x4StructTy =
1762  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {i32Ty, i32Ty, i32Ty, i32Ty});
1763  auto f32x8StructTy =
1764  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, SmallVector<Type>(8, f32Ty));
1765  auto f16x2x2StructTy =
1766  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {f16x2Ty, f16x2Ty});
1767  auto f32x4StructTy =
1768  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty});
1769  auto s32x2StructTy =
1770  LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(context, {i32Ty, i32Ty});
1771 
1772  std::array<int64_t, 3> mmaShape{getShapeAttr().getM(), getShapeAttr().getN(),
1773  getShapeAttr().getK()};
1774 
1775  // These variables define the set of allowed data types for matrices A, B, C,
1776  // and result.
1777  using AllowedShapes = SmallVector<std::array<int64_t, 3>, 2>;
1778  using AllowedTypes = SmallVector<SmallVector<Type, 4>, 2>;
1779  AllowedShapes allowedShapes;
1780  AllowedTypes expectedA;
1781  AllowedTypes expectedB;
1782  AllowedTypes expectedC;
1783  SmallVector<Type> expectedResult;
1784 
1785  // When M = 16, we just need to calculate the number of 8xk tiles, where
1786  // k is a factor that depends on the data type.
1787  if (mmaShape[0] == 16) {
1788  int64_t kFactor;
1789  Type multiplicandFragType;
1790  switch (*getMultiplicandAPtxType()) {
1791  case MMATypes::tf32:
1792  kFactor = 4;
1793  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1794  expectedResult.push_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1795  context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty}));
1796  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k8 and m16n8k16 for tf32
1797  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 8});
1798  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 16});
1799  break;
1800  case MMATypes::bf16:
1801  kFactor = 8;
1802  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1803  expectedResult.push_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1804  context, {f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty, f32Ty}));
1805  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k16 and m16n8k32 for bf16
1806  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 16});
1807  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 32});
1808  break;
1809  case MMATypes::f16:
1810  kFactor = 8;
1811  multiplicandFragType = f16x2Ty;
1812  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x2StructTy);
1813  expectedResult.push_back(f32x4StructTy);
1814  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k16 and m16n8k32 for f16
1815  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 16});
1816  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 32});
1817  break;
1818  case MMATypes::s4:
1819  case MMATypes::u4:
1820  kFactor = 32;
1821  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k64 and m16n8k128 for s4/u4
1822  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 64});
1823  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 128});
1824  break;
1825  case MMATypes::s8:
1826  case MMATypes::u8:
1827  kFactor = 16;
1828  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k32 and m16n8k64 for s8/u8
1829  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 32});
1830  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 64});
1831  break;
1832  case MMATypes::e4m3:
1833  case MMATypes::e5m2:
1834  case MMATypes::e3m2:
1835  case MMATypes::e2m3:
1836  case MMATypes::e2m1:
1837  kFactor = 16;
1838  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1839  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x2StructTy);
1840  expectedResult.push_back(f32x4StructTy);
1841  // Sparse MMA supports m16n8k64 for FP8 types
1842  allowedShapes.push_back({16, 8, 64});
1843  break;
1844  default:
1845  return emitError("invalid shape or multiplicand type: ")
1846  << getMultiplicandAPtxType().value();
1847  }
1848 
1849  if (isIntegerPtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value())) {
1850  expectedResult.push_back(s32x4StructTy);
1851  expectedC.emplace_back(4, i32Ty);
1852  multiplicandFragType = i32Ty;
1853  } else if (*getMultiplicandAPtxType() >= MMATypes::e4m3 &&
1854  *getMultiplicandAPtxType() <= MMATypes::e2m1) {
1855  // FP8 types
1856  expectedC.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1857  expectedC.emplace_back(4, f32Ty);
1858  } else {
1859  expectedC.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1860  expectedC.emplace_back(4, f32Ty);
1861  }
1862 
1863  // For sparse MMA, A operand is compressed (2:4 sparsity means half the
1864  // elements)
1865  int64_t unitA = (mmaShape[0] / 8) * (mmaShape[2] / kFactor) / 2;
1866  int64_t unitB = (mmaShape[1] / 8) * (mmaShape[2] / kFactor);
1867  expectedA.emplace_back(unitA, multiplicandFragType);
1868  expectedB.emplace_back(unitB, multiplicandFragType);
1869 
1870  if (resultPtxType() != accumPtxType())
1871  return emitOpError("ctype does not match dtype");
1872  }
1873 
1874  // In the M=8 case, there is only 1 possible case per data type.
1875  if (mmaShape[0] == 8) {
1876  if (*getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::f16) {
1877  expectedA.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1878  expectedB.emplace_back(2, f16x2Ty);
1879  expectedResult.push_back(f16x2x4StructTy);
1880  expectedResult.push_back(f32x8StructTy);
1881  expectedC.emplace_back(4, f16x2Ty);
1882  expectedC.emplace_back(8, f32Ty);
1883  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 4});
1884  }
1885  if (*getMultiplicandAPtxType() == MMATypes::f64) {
1886  Type f64Ty = Float64Type::get(context);
1887  expectedA.emplace_back(1, f64Ty);
1888  expectedB.emplace_back(1, f64Ty);
1889  expectedC.emplace_back(2, f64Ty);
1890  expectedResult.emplace_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
1891  context, SmallVector<Type>(2, f64Ty)));
1892  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 4});
1893  }
1894  if (isIntegerPtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value())) {
1895  expectedA.push_back({i32Ty});
1896  expectedB.push_back({i32Ty});
1897  expectedC.push_back({i32Ty, i32Ty});
1898  expectedResult.push_back(s32x2StructTy);
1899  if (isInt4PtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value()))
1900  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 32});
1901  if (isInt8PtxType(getMultiplicandAPtxType().value()))
1902  allowedShapes.push_back({8, 8, 16});
1903  }
1904  }
1905 
1906  std::string errorMessage;
1907  llvm::raw_string_ostream errorStream(errorMessage);
1908 
1909  // Check that we matched an existing shape/dtype combination.
1910  if (expectedA.empty() || expectedB.empty() || expectedC.empty() ||
1911  !llvm::is_contained(allowedShapes, mmaShape)) {
1912  errorStream << "unimplemented variant for MMA shape <";
1913  llvm::interleaveComma(mmaShape, errorStream);
1914  errorStream << ">";
1915  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1916  }
1917 
1918  // Verify the operand types for segments of A, B, and C operands.
1919  std::array<StringRef, 3> operandNames{"A", "B", "C"};
1920  for (const auto &iter : llvm::enumerate(
1921  SmallVector<AllowedTypes, 3>{expectedA, expectedB, expectedC})) {
1922  auto spec = this->getODSOperandIndexAndLength(iter.index());
1923  SmallVector<Type, 4> operandTySeg(operand_type_begin() + spec.first,
1924  operand_type_begin() + spec.first +
1925  spec.second);
1926  bool match = llvm::is_contained(iter.value(), operandTySeg);
1927 
1928  if (!match) {
1929  errorStream << "Could not match types for the "
1930  << operandNames[iter.index()]
1931  << " operands; expected one of ";
1932  for (const auto &x : iter.value()) {
1933  errorStream << x.size() << "x" << x[0] << " ";
1934  }
1935  errorStream << "but got ";
1936  llvm::interleaveComma(operandTySeg, errorStream);
1937  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1938  }
1939  }
1940 
1941  // Check the result type
1942  if (!llvm::any_of(expectedResult, [&](Type expectedResultType) {
1943  return expectedResultType == getResult().getType();
1944  })) {
1945  errorStream
1946  << "Could not match allowed types for the result; expected one of ";
1947  llvm::interleaveComma(expectedResult, errorStream);
1948  errorStream << " but got " << getResult().getType();
1949  return emitOpError(errorMessage);
1950  }
1951 
1952  // Ensure int4/int8 MMA variants specify the accum overflow behavior
1953  // attribute.
1954  if (isInt4PtxType(*getMultiplicandAPtxType()) ||
1955  isInt8PtxType(*getMultiplicandAPtxType())) {
1956  if (!getIntOverflowBehavior())
1957  return emitOpError("op requires " +
1958  getIntOverflowBehaviorAttrName().strref() +
1959  " attribute");
1960  }
1961 
1962  // Validate sparse metadata type (should be i32)
1963  if (!getSparseMetadata().getType().isInteger(32)) {
1964  return emitOpError() << "sparse metadata must be i32 type";
1965  }
1966 
1967  // Validate sparsity selector type (should be i32)
1968  if (!getSparsitySelector().getType().isInteger(32)) {
1969  return emitOpError() << "sparsity selector must be i32 type";
1970  }
1971 
1972  return success();
1973 }
1974 
1975 //===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
1976 // MMA Block Scale Operations - Shared Helpers
1977 //===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
1978 
1979 namespace {
1980 // Shared structure for MMA operand fragments (A, B, C)
1981 struct MMAOperandFragment {
1982  StringRef operandName;
1983  StringRef ptxTypeAttr;
1984  SmallVector<Value, 4> regs;
1985  explicit MMAOperandFragment(StringRef name, StringRef ptxTypeName)
1986  : operandName(name), ptxTypeAttr(ptxTypeName) {}
1987 };
1988 } // namespace
1989 
1990 // Helper to print operand list in the format: name[operands]
1991 static void printOperandList(OpAsmPrinter &p, StringRef name,
1992  ArrayRef<Value> operands) {
1993  p << " " << name << "[";
1994  p.printOperands(operands);
1995  p << "]";
1996 }
1997 
1998 // Helper to parse operand list in the format: name[operands]
1999 static LogicalResult
2000 parseMmaOperand(OpAsmParser &parser, StringRef operandName,
2001  SmallVectorImpl<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> &regs) {
2002  if (parser.parseKeyword(operandName).failed())
2003  return failure();
2004  if (parser.parseOperandList(regs, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::OptionalSquare)
2005  .failed())
2006  return failure();
2007  return success();
2008 }
2009 
2010 // Helper to process operand fragments and determine which attributes can be
2011 // inferred
2012 template <typename Op>
2013 static void
2014 processOperandFragments(Op &op, std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 3> &frags,
2015  SmallVectorImpl<Type> &regTypes,
2016  SmallVectorImpl<StringRef> &ignoreAttrNames) {
2017  for (unsigned fragIdx = 0; fragIdx < frags.size(); fragIdx++) {
2018  auto &frag = frags[fragIdx];
2019  auto varOperandSpec = op.getODSOperandIndexAndLength(fragIdx);
2020  for (auto operandIdx = varOperandSpec.first;
2021  operandIdx < varOperandSpec.first + varOperandSpec.second;
2022  operandIdx++) {
2023  frag.regs.push_back(op.getOperand(operandIdx));
2024  if (fragIdx == 0 && operandIdx == varOperandSpec.first) {
2025  regTypes.push_back(op.getOperand(operandIdx).getType());
2026  }
2027  }
2028  if (fragIdx < 2) {
2029  regTypes.push_back(frag.regs[0].getType());
2030  }
2031  std::optional<MMATypes> inferredType =
2032  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(regTypes.back(),
2033  /*isAccumulator=*/fragIdx >= 2);
2034  if (inferredType)
2035  ignoreAttrNames.push_back(frag.ptxTypeAttr);
2036  }
2037 }
2038 
2039 // Helper to parse type signature: (A_type, B_type, C_type)
2040 static LogicalResult
2041 parseMmaTypeSignature(OpAsmParser &parser,
2042  SmallVectorImpl<Type> &operandTypes) {
2043  if (parser.parseColon().failed() || parser.parseLParen().failed())
2044  return failure();
2045 
2046  auto typeParser = [&]() {
2047  Type ty;
2048  if (parser.parseType(ty).failed())
2049  return failure();
2050  operandTypes.push_back(ty);
2051  return success();
2052  };
2053  if (parser.parseCommaSeparatedList(typeParser))
2054  return failure();
2055 
2056  if (operandTypes.size() != 3)
2057  return parser.emitError(parser.getCurrentLocation(),
2058  "expected exactly 3 types");
2059 
2060  return parser.parseRParen();
2061 }
2062 
2063 // Helper to infer and set multiplicand PTX type attributes
2064 static void
2065 inferAndSetMultiplicandTypes(MLIRContext *ctx, NamedAttrList &attrs,
2066  const SmallVectorImpl<Type> &operandTypes) {
2067  if (!attrs.get("multiplicandAPtxType")) {
2068  if (auto inferredType =
2069  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandTypes[0], false)) {
2070  attrs.set("multiplicandAPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *inferredType));
2071  }
2072  }
2073  if (!attrs.get("multiplicandBPtxType")) {
2074  if (auto inferredType =
2075  MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandTypes[1], false)) {
2076  attrs.set("multiplicandBPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *inferredType));
2077  }
2078  }
2079 }
2080 
2081 // Helper to add common block scale properties
2082 template <typename OpType>
2083 static void addBlockScaleProperties(OpBuilder &builder, OperationState &result,
2084  ArrayRef<int64_t> shape,
2085  ScaleVecSize scaleVecSize,
2086  BlockScaleFormat blockScaleFormat,
2087  MMABlockScaleKind kind) {
2088  MLIRContext *ctx = builder.getContext();
2089  auto &properties = result.getOrAddProperties<typename OpType::Properties>();
2090  properties.setShape(
2091  builder.getAttr<MMAShapeAttr>(shape[0], shape[1], shape[2]));
2092  properties.setScaleVecSize(ScaleVecSizeAttr::get(ctx, scaleVecSize));
2093  properties.setBlockScaleFormat(
2094  BlockScaleFormatAttr::get(ctx, blockScaleFormat));
2095  properties.setKind(MMABlockScaleKindAttr::get(ctx, kind));
2096 }
2097 
2098 // Helper to infer and add multiplicand PTX types to builder
2099 static void addInferredMultiplicandTypes(
2100  MLIRContext *ctx, OperationState &result, ValueRange operandA,
2101  ValueRange operandB,
2102  std::optional<std::array<MMATypes, 2>> multiplicandPtxTypes) {
2103  if (multiplicandPtxTypes) {
2104  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType",
2105  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[0]));
2106  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType",
2107  MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, (*multiplicandPtxTypes)[1]));
2108  } else {
2109  if (auto res = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandA[0].getType(), false))
2110  result.addAttribute("multiplicandAPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
2111  if (auto res = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandB[0].getType(), false))
2112  result.addAttribute("multiplicandBPtxType", MMATypesAttr::get(ctx, *res));
2113  }
2114 }
2115 
2116 // Template helper for common accumPtxType/resultPtxType implementation
2117 template <typename OpTy>
2118 static MMATypes inferPtxTypeFromResult(OpTy op) {
2119  return *MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(
2120  cast<LLVM::LLVMStructType>(op.getRes().getType()).getBody()[0],
2121  /*isAccumulator=*/true);
2122 }

2127 
2128 void MmaBlockScaleOp::print(OpAsmPrinter &p) {
2129  SmallVector<Type, 4> regTypes;
2130  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 3> frags{
2131  MMAOperandFragment("A", getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()),
2132  MMAOperandFragment("B", getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()),
2133  MMAOperandFragment("C", "")};
2134  SmallVector<StringRef, 4> ignoreAttrNames{
2135  mlir::NVVM::MmaBlockScaleOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr()};
2136 
2137  processOperandFragments(*this, frags, regTypes, ignoreAttrNames);
2138 
2139  // Print A, B, C operands
2140  for (const auto &frag : frags)
2141  printOperandList(p, frag.operandName, frag.regs);
2142 
2143  // Print scale operands
2144  printOperandList(p, "scaleA",
2145  {getScaleAData(), getByteIdA(), getThreadIdA()});
2146  printOperandList(p, "scaleB",
2147  {getScaleBData(), getByteIdB(), getThreadIdB()});
2148 
2149  bool isFirstProperty = true;
2150  printMmaProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "shape", getShapeAttr());
2151  if (getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr() &&
2152  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()))
2153  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
2154  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr());
2155  if (getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr() &&
2156  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()))
2157  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_b_ptx_type",
2158  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr());
2159  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "scale_vec_size",
2160  getScaleVecSizeAttr());
2161  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "block_scale_format",
2162  getBlockScaleFormatAttr());
2163  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "kind", getKindAttr());
2164  llvm::append_range(
2165  ignoreAttrNames,
2166  ArrayRef<StringRef>{getShapeAttrName(), getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName(),
2167  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName(),
2168  getScaleVecSizeAttrName(),
2169  getBlockScaleFormatAttrName(), getKindAttrName()});
2170  p.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getDiscardableAttrDictionary().getValue(),
2171  ignoreAttrNames);
2172 
2173  // Print type signature
2174  p << " : (";
2175  llvm::interleaveComma(SmallVector<Type, 3>{frags[0].regs[0].getType(),
2176  frags[1].regs[0].getType(),
2177  frags[2].regs[0].getType()},
2178  p);
2179  p << ")";
2180  p.printArrowTypeList(TypeRange{this->getRes().getType()});
2181 }
2182 
2183 ParseResult MmaBlockScaleOp::parse(OpAsmParser &parser,
2184  OperationState &result) {
2185  struct LocalOperandFragment {
2186  std::optional<MMATypes> elemtype;
2187  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 4> regs;
2188  };
2189 
2190  Builder &builder = parser.getBuilder();
2191  std::array<LocalOperandFragment, 3> frags;
2192  NamedAttrList namedAttributes;
2193 
2194  // Parse A[...] B[...] C[...]
2195  if (parseMmaOperand(parser, "A", frags[0].regs).failed() ||
2196  parseMmaOperand(parser, "B", frags[1].regs).failed() ||
2197  parseMmaOperand(parser, "C", frags[2].regs).failed())
2198  return failure();
2199 
2200  // Parse scale operands: scaleA[...] scaleB[...]
2201  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 3> scaleAOperands, scaleBOperands;
2202  if (parseMmaOperand(parser, "scaleA", scaleAOperands).failed() ||
2203  parseMmaOperand(parser, "scaleB", scaleBOperands).failed())
2204  return failure();
2205 
2206  if (parseMmaProperties(parser, namedAttributes,
2207  {"shape", "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
2208  "multiplicand_b_ptx_type", "scale_vec_size",
2209  "block_scale_format", "kind"},
2210  {"shape", "scaleVecSize", "blockScaleFormat", "kind"}))
2211  return failure();
2212 
2213  // Parse type signature
2214  SmallVector<Type, 3> operandTypes;
2215  if (parseMmaTypeSignature(parser, operandTypes).failed())
2216  return failure();
2217 
2218  // Parse result type
2219  SmallVector<Type, 1> resultTypes;
2220  if (parser.parseArrowTypeList(resultTypes).failed())
2221  return failure();
2222 
2223  // Infer element types and resolve operands
2224  for (const auto &[idx, frag] : llvm::enumerate(frags)) {
2225  frag.elemtype = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandTypes[idx],
2226  /*isAccumulator=*/idx >= 2);
2227  if (parser
2228  .resolveOperands(frag.regs, operandTypes[idx], parser.getNameLoc(),
2229  result.operands)
2230  .failed())
2231  return failure();
2232  }
2233 
2234  // Resolve scale operands
2235  SmallVector<Type, 3> scaleTypes = {builder.getI32Type(), builder.getI16Type(),
2236  builder.getI16Type()};
2237  if (parser

2239  result.operands)
2240  .failed() ||

2250  operandTypes);

2335 LogicalResult MmaBlockScaleOp::verify() {
2336  LogicalResult result = success();
2337  int m = getShape().getM();
2338  int n = getShape().getN();
2339  int k = getShape().getK();
2340 
2341  if (m == 16 && n == 8 && k == 64) {
2342  if (getMultiplicandAPtxType() != NVVM::MMATypes::e2m1 ||
2343  getMultiplicandBPtxType() != NVVM::MMATypes::e2m1)
2344  result = emitOpError(
2345  "unsupported MMATypes attribute for mma.m16n8k64.(mxf4nvf4|mxf4)");
2346  if (getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF4) {
2347  if (getScaleVecSize() != NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X2)
2348  result = emitOpError(
2349  "unsupported ScaleVecSize attribute for mma.m16n8k64.mxf4");
2350  if (getBlockScaleFormat() != NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0)
2351  result = emitOpError(
2352  "unsupported BlockScaleFormat attribute for mma.m16n8k64.mxf4");
2353  } else if (getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF4NVF4) {
2354  if (!((getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X2 &&
2355  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0) ||
2356  (getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X4 &&
2357  (getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE4M3 ||
2358  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0))))
2359  result = emitOpError("unsupported ScaleVecSize and BlockScaleFormat "
2360  "attributes for mma.m16n8k64.mxf4nvf4");
2361  } else {
2362  result = emitOpError("unsupported Kind attribute for mma.m16n8k64");
2363  }
2364  } else if (m == 16 && n == 8 && k == 32) {
2365  if (!(getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF8F6F4 &&
2366  getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X1 &&
2367  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0))
2368  result =
2369  emitOpError("unsupported Kind, ScaleVecSize and BlockScaleFormat "
2370  "attributes for mma.m16n8k32");
2371  } else {
2372  result = emitOpError("unsupported Geom for mma with block scaling");
2373  }
2374  return result;
2375 }

2381 void MmaSpBlockScaleOp::print(OpAsmPrinter &p) {
2382  SmallVector<Type, 4> regTypes;
2383  std::array<MMAOperandFragment, 3> frags{
2384  MMAOperandFragment("A", getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()),
2385  MMAOperandFragment("B", getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()),
2386  MMAOperandFragment("C", "")};
2387  SmallVector<StringRef, 4> ignoreAttrNames{
2388  mlir::NVVM::MmaSpBlockScaleOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr()};
2389 
2390  processOperandFragments(*this, frags, regTypes, ignoreAttrNames);
2391 
2392  // Print A, B, C operands
2393  for (const auto &frag : frags)
2394  printOperandList(p, frag.operandName, frag.regs);
2395 
2396  // Print sparse-specific operands
2397  printOperandList(p, "sparseMetadata", {getSparseMetadata()});
2398  printOperandList(p, "selector", {getSparsitySelector()});
2399 
2400  // Print scale operands
2401  printOperandList(p, "scaleA",
2402  {getScaleAData(), getByteIdA(), getThreadIdA()});
2403  printOperandList(p, "scaleB",
2404  {getScaleBData(), getByteIdB(), getThreadIdB()});
2405 
2406  bool isFirstProperty = true;
2407  printMmaProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "shape", getShapeAttr());
2408  if (getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr() &&
2409  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName()))
2410  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
2411  getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttr());
2412  if (getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr() &&
2413  !llvm::is_contained(ignoreAttrNames, getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName()))
2414  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "multiplicand_b_ptx_type",
2415  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttr());
2416  printMmaUnitProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "ordered_metadata");
2417  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "scale_vec_size",
2418  getScaleVecSizeAttr());
2419  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "block_scale_format",
2420  getBlockScaleFormatAttr());
2421  printMmaEnumProperty(p, isFirstProperty, "kind", getKindAttr());
2422  llvm::append_range(
2423  ignoreAttrNames,
2424  ArrayRef<StringRef>{getShapeAttrName(), getMultiplicandAPtxTypeAttrName(),
2425  getMultiplicandBPtxTypeAttrName(),
2426  getOrderedMetadataAttrName(),
2427  getScaleVecSizeAttrName(),
2428  getBlockScaleFormatAttrName(), getKindAttrName()});
2429  p.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getDiscardableAttrDictionary().getValue(),
2430  ignoreAttrNames);
2431 
2432  // Print type signature
2433  p << " : (";
2434  llvm::interleaveComma(SmallVector<Type, 3>{frags[0].regs[0].getType(),
2435  frags[1].regs[0].getType(),
2436  frags[2].regs[0].getType()},
2437  p);
2438  p << ")";
2439  p.printArrowTypeList(TypeRange{this->getRes().getType()});
2440 }
