2442 ParseResult MmaSpBlockScaleOp::parse(OpAsmParser &parser,
2443  OperationState &result) {
2444  struct LocalOperandFragment {
2445  std::optional<MMATypes> elemtype;
2446  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 4> regs;
2447  };
2448 
2449  Builder &builder = parser.getBuilder();
2450  std::array<LocalOperandFragment, 3> frags;
2451  NamedAttrList namedAttributes;
2452 
2453  // Parse A[...] B[...] C[...]
2454  if (parseMmaOperand(parser, "A", frags[0].regs).failed() ||
2455  parseMmaOperand(parser, "B", frags[1].regs).failed() ||
2456  parseMmaOperand(parser, "C", frags[2].regs).failed())
2457  return failure();
2458 
2459  // Parse sparse-specific operands
2460  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 1> metadataOperands,
2461  selectorOperands;
2462  if (parseMmaOperand(parser, "sparseMetadata", metadataOperands).failed() ||
2463  parseMmaOperand(parser, "selector", selectorOperands).failed())
2464  return failure();
2465 
2466  // Parse scale operands
2467  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand, 3> scaleAOperands, scaleBOperands;
2468  if (parseMmaOperand(parser, "scaleA", scaleAOperands).failed() ||
2469  parseMmaOperand(parser, "scaleB", scaleBOperands).failed())
2470  return failure();
2471 
2472  if (parseMmaProperties(parser, namedAttributes,
2473  {"shape", "multiplicand_a_ptx_type",
2474  "multiplicand_b_ptx_type", "ordered_metadata",
2475  "scale_vec_size", "block_scale_format", "kind"},
2476  {"shape", "scaleVecSize", "blockScaleFormat", "kind"}))
2477  return failure();
2478 
2479  // Parse type signature
2480  SmallVector<Type, 3> operandTypes;
2481  if (parseMmaTypeSignature(parser, operandTypes).failed())
2482  return failure();
2483 
2484  // Parse result type
2485  SmallVector<Type, 1> resultTypes;
2486  if (parser.parseArrowTypeList(resultTypes).failed())
2487  return failure();
2488 
2489  // Infer element types and resolve operands
2490  for (const auto &[idx, frag] : llvm::enumerate(frags)) {
2491  frag.elemtype = MmaOp::inferOperandMMAType(operandTypes[idx],
2492  /*isAccumulator=*/idx >= 2);
2493  if (parser
2494  .resolveOperands(frag.regs, operandTypes[idx], parser.getNameLoc(),
2495  result.operands)
2496  .failed())
2497  return failure();
2498  }
2499 
2500  // Resolve sparse metadata and selector
2501  Type i32Type = builder.getI32Type();
2502  if (parser
2503  .resolveOperands(metadataOperands, i32Type, parser.getNameLoc(),
2504  result.operands)
2505  .failed() ||
2506  parser
2507  .resolveOperands(selectorOperands, i32Type, parser.getNameLoc(),
2508  result.operands)
2509  .failed())
2510  return failure();
2511 
2512  // Resolve scale operands
2513  SmallVector<Type, 3> scaleTypes = {i32Type, builder.getI16Type(),
2514  builder.getI16Type()};
2515  if (parser
2516  .resolveOperands(scaleAOperands, scaleTypes, parser.getNameLoc(),
2517  result.operands)
2518  .failed() ||
2519  parser
2520  .resolveOperands(scaleBOperands, scaleTypes, parser.getNameLoc(),
2521  result.operands)
2522  .failed())
2523  return failure();
2524 
2525  // Add attributes
2526  result.addAttributes(namedAttributes);
2527  inferAndSetMultiplicandTypes(parser.getContext(), result.attributes,
2528  operandTypes);
2529 
2530  // orderedMetadata is mandatory
2531  if (!result.attributes.get("orderedMetadata"))
2532  result.addAttribute("orderedMetadata", builder.getUnitAttr());
2533 
2534  result.addTypes(resultTypes);
2535  result.addAttribute(MmaSpBlockScaleOp::getOperandSegmentSizeAttr(),
2536  builder.getDenseI32ArrayAttr({
2537  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[0].regs.size()),
2538  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[1].regs.size()),
2539  static_cast<int32_t>(frags[2].regs.size()),
2540  1, // sparseMetadata
2541  1, // sparsitySelector
2542  1, // scaleAData
2543  1, // byteIdA
2544  1, // threadIdA
2545  1, // scaleBData
2546  1, // byteIdB
2547  1 // threadIdB
2548  }));
2549  return success();
2550 }

2628  // Check that orderedMetadata is present

2633  LogicalResult result = success();

2636  int k = getShape().getK();

2638  if (m == 16 && n == 8 && k == 128) {

2641  result = emitOpError(
2642  "unsupported MMATypes attribute for mma.m16n8k128.(mxf4nvf4|mxf4)");
2643  if (getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF4) {
2644  if (getScaleVecSize() != NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X2)

2647  if (getBlockScaleFormat() != NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0)
2648  result = emitOpError(
2649  "unsupported BlockScaleFormat attribute for mma.m16n8k128.mxf4");
2650  } else if (getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF4NVF4) {
2651  if (!((getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X2 &&
2652  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0) ||
2653  (getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X4 &&
2654  (getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE4M3 ||
2655  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0))))
2656  result = emitOpError("unsupported ScaleVecSize and BlockScaleFormat "
2657  "attributes for mma.m16n8k128.mxf4nvf4");
2658  } else {
2659  result = emitOpError("unsupported Kind attribute for mma.m16n8k128");
2660  }
2661  } else if (m == 16 && n == 8 && k == 64) {
2662  if (!(getKind() == NVVM::MMABlockScaleKind::MXF8F6F4 &&
2663  getScaleVecSize() == NVVM::ScaleVecSize::X1 &&
2664  getBlockScaleFormat() == NVVM::BlockScaleFormat::UE8M0))

2666  emitOpError("unsupported Kind, ScaleVecSize and BlockScaleFormat "
2667  "attributes for mma.m16n8k64");

2670  }

2674 LogicalResult ShflOp::verify() {
2675  auto returnStructType = llvm::dyn_cast<LLVM::LLVMStructType>(getType());
2676 
2677  auto verifyTypeError = [&](Twine desc, Type expectedType,
2678  Type actualType) -> LogicalResult {
2679  return emitOpError("expected " + desc + " to be of type ")
2680  << expectedType << " but got " << actualType << " instead";
2681  };
2682 
2683  if (returnStructType) {
2684  if (!getReturnValueAndIsValid())
2685  return emitOpError("\"return_value_and_is_valid\" attribute must be "
2686  "specified when the return type is a struct type");
2687 
2688  if (returnStructType.getBody().size() != 2)
2689  return emitOpError("expected return type to be a two-element struct");
2690 
2691  llvm::ArrayRef<Type> returnStruct = returnStructType.getBody();
2692  auto resultType = returnStruct[0];
2693  if (resultType != getVal().getType())
2694  return verifyTypeError("first element in the returned struct",
2695  getVal().getType(), resultType);
2696 
2697  auto predicateType = returnStruct[1];
2698  if (!predicateType.isInteger(1))
2699  return verifyTypeError("second element in the returned struct",
2700  mlir::IntegerType::get(getContext(), 1),
2701  predicateType);
2702  } else {
2703  if (getReturnValueAndIsValid())
2704  return emitOpError("expected return type to be a two-element struct");
2705 
2706  if (getType() != getVal().getType())
2707  return verifyTypeError("return type", getVal().getType(), getType());
2708  }
2709  return success();
2710 }

2712 LogicalResult
2713 ShflOp::inferReturnTypes(MLIRContext *context, std::optional<Location> location,
2714  ShflOp::Adaptor adaptor,
2715  SmallVectorImpl<Type> &inferredReturnTypes) {
2716  Type valType = adaptor.getVal().getType();
2717  if (adaptor.getReturnValueAndIsValid())
2718  inferredReturnTypes.push_back(LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
2719  context, {valType, IntegerType::get(context, 1)}));
2720  else
2721  inferredReturnTypes.push_back(valType);
2722  return success();
2723 }
2724 
2725 std::pair<mlir::Type, unsigned> NVVM::inferMMAType(NVVM::MMATypes type,
2726  NVVM::MMAFrag frag, int nRow,
2727  int nCol,
2728  MLIRContext *context) {
2729  unsigned numberElements = 0;
2730  Type elementType;
2731  OpBuilder builder(context);
2732  Type f16x2 = VectorType::get(2, builder.getF16Type());
2733  if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::f16) {
2734  elementType = f16x2;
2735  if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::a || frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::b)
2736  numberElements = 8;
2737  else
2738  numberElements = 4;
2739  } else if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::f32) {
2740  elementType = builder.getF32Type();
2741  numberElements = 8;
2742  } else if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::f64) {
2743  elementType = builder.getF64Type();
2744  if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::a || frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::b)
2745  numberElements = 1;
2746  else
2747  numberElements = 2;
2748  } else if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::tf32) {
2749  elementType = builder.getI32Type();
2750  numberElements = 4;
2751  } else if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::s8 || type == NVVM::MMATypes::u8) {
2752  elementType = builder.getI32Type();
2753  int parallelSize = 0;
2754  if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::a)
2755  parallelSize = nRow;
2756  if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::b)
2757  parallelSize = nCol;
2758 
2759  // m == 16 && n == 16 && k == 16
2760  if (parallelSize == 16)
2761  numberElements = 2;
2762  // m == 8 && n == 32 && k == 16 or m == 32 && n == 8 && k == 16
2763  else if (parallelSize == 8)
2764  numberElements = 1;
2765  else if (parallelSize == 32)
2766  numberElements = 4;
2767  } else if (type == NVVM::MMATypes::s32) {
2768  elementType = builder.getI32Type();
2769  numberElements = 8;
2770  }
2771  assert(numberElements != 0 && elementType != nullptr);
2772  return std::make_pair(elementType, numberElements);
2773 }
2774 
2775 static std::pair<mlir::Type, unsigned>
2776 inferMMATypeFromMNK(NVVM::MMATypes type, NVVM::MMAFrag frag, int m, int n,
2777  int k, MLIRContext *context) {
2778  int nRow, nCol;
2779  if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::a) {
2780  nRow = m;
2781  nCol = k;
2782  } else if (frag == NVVM::MMAFrag::b) {
2783  nRow = k;
2784  nCol = n;
2785  } else {
2786  nRow = m;
2787  nCol = n;
2788  }
2789  assert(nRow && nCol);
2790  return inferMMAType(type, frag, nRow, nCol, context);
2791 }

2793 LogicalResult NVVM::WMMALoadOp::verify() {
2794  unsigned addressSpace =
2795  llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(getPtr().getType()).getAddressSpace();
2796  if (addressSpace != 0 && addressSpace != NVVMMemorySpace::Global &&
2797  addressSpace != NVVMMemorySpace::Shared)
2798  return emitOpError("expected source pointer in memory "
2799  "space 0, 1, 3");
2800 
2801  if (NVVM::WMMALoadOp::getIntrinsicID(getM(), getN(), getK(), getLayout(),
2802  getEltype(), getFrag()) == 0)
2803  return emitOpError() << "invalid attribute combination";
2804  std::pair<Type, unsigned> typeInfo = inferMMATypeFromMNK(
2805  getEltype(), getFrag(), getM(), getN(), getK(), getContext());
2806  // Special case for f64 fragments
2807  Type f64Ty = Float64Type::get(getContext());
2808  if (typeInfo.first == f64Ty && typeInfo.second == 1) {
2809  if (getType() != f64Ty)
2810  return emitOpError("expected destination type to be f64");
2811  return success();
2812  }
2813  // Everything else is a struct
2814  Type dstType = LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
2815  getContext(), SmallVector<Type, 8>(typeInfo.second, typeInfo.first));
2816  if (getType() != dstType)
2817  return emitOpError("expected destination type is a structure of ")
2818  << typeInfo.second << " elements of type " << typeInfo.first;
2819  return success();
2820 }

2822 LogicalResult NVVM::WMMAStoreOp::verify() {
2823  unsigned addressSpace =
2824  llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(getPtr().getType()).getAddressSpace();
2825  if (addressSpace != 0 && addressSpace != NVVMMemorySpace::Global &&
2826  addressSpace != NVVMMemorySpace::Shared)
2827  return emitOpError("expected operands to be a source pointer in memory "
2828  "space 0, 1, 3");
2829 
2830  if (NVVM::WMMAStoreOp::getIntrinsicID(getM(), getN(), getK(), getLayout(),
2831  getEltype()) == 0)
2832  return emitOpError() << "invalid attribute combination";
2833  std::pair<Type, unsigned> typeInfo = inferMMATypeFromMNK(
2834  getEltype(), NVVM::MMAFrag::c, getM(), getN(), getK(), getContext());
2835  if (getArgs().size() != typeInfo.second)
2836  return emitOpError() << "expected " << typeInfo.second << " data operands";
2837  if (llvm::any_of(getArgs(), [&typeInfo](Value operands) {
2838  return operands.getType() != typeInfo.first;
2839  }))
2840  return emitOpError() << "expected data operands of type " << typeInfo.first;
2841  return success();
2842 }

2844 LogicalResult NVVM::WMMAMmaOp::verify() {
2845  if (NVVM::WMMAMmaOp::getIntrinsicID(getM(), getN(), getK(), getLayoutA(),
2846  getLayoutB(), getEltypeA(),
2847  getEltypeB()) == 0)
2848  return emitOpError() << "invalid attribute combination";
2849  std::pair<Type, unsigned> typeInfoA = inferMMATypeFromMNK(
2850  getEltypeA(), NVVM::MMAFrag::a, getM(), getN(), getK(), getContext());
2851  std::pair<Type, unsigned> typeInfoB = inferMMATypeFromMNK(
2852  getEltypeA(), NVVM::MMAFrag::b, getM(), getN(), getK(), getContext());
2853  std::pair<Type, unsigned> typeInfoC = inferMMATypeFromMNK(
2854  getEltypeB(), NVVM::MMAFrag::c, getM(), getN(), getK(), getContext());
2855  SmallVector<Type, 32> arguments;
2856  arguments.append(typeInfoA.second, typeInfoA.first);
2857  arguments.append(typeInfoB.second, typeInfoB.first);
2858  arguments.append(typeInfoC.second, typeInfoC.first);
2859  unsigned numArgs = arguments.size();
2860  if (getArgs().size() != numArgs)
2861  return emitOpError() << "expected " << numArgs << " arguments";
2862  for (unsigned i = 0; i < numArgs; i++) {
2863  if (getArgs()[i].getType() != arguments[i])
2864  return emitOpError() << "expected argument " << i << " to be of type "
2865  << arguments[i];
2866  }
2867  Type dstType = LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
2868  getContext(), SmallVector<Type, 8>(typeInfoC.second, typeInfoC.first));
2869  if (getType() != dstType)
2870  return emitOpError("expected destination type is a structure of ")
2871  << typeInfoC.second << " elements of type " << typeInfoC.first;
2872  return success();
2873 }

2875 LogicalResult NVVM::LdMatrixOp::verify() {
2876  uint32_t num = getNum(), m = getShape().getM(), n = getShape().getN();
2877  if (m == 8 && n == 8) {
2878  if (num != 1 && num != 2 && num != 4) {
2879  return emitOpError("expected num attribute to be 1, 2 or 4 for 8x8 "
2880  "matrix");
2881  }
2882  if (getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B16) {
2883  return emitOpError("expected element type to be b16 for 8x8 matrix");
2884  }
2885  } else if (m == 8 && n == 16) {
2886  if (num != 1 && num != 2 && num != 4) {
2887  return emitOpError("expected num attribute to be 1, 2 or 4 for 8x16 "
2888  "matrix");
2889  }
2890  if (getLayout() != MMALayout::row) {
2891  return emitOpError("expected layout to be row for 8x16 matrix");
2892  }
2893  if (getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B8X16_B4X16_P64 &&
2894  getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B8X16_B6X16_P32) {
2895  return emitOpError("expected element type to be b8x16.b4x16_p64 or "
2896  "b8x16.b6x16_p32 for 8x16 matrix");
2897  }
2898  } else if (m == 16 && n == 16) {
2899  if (num != 1 && num != 2) {
2900  return emitOpError("expected num attribute to be 1 or 2 for 16x16 "
2901  "matrix");
2902  }
2903  if (getLayout() != MMALayout::col) {
2904  return emitOpError("expected layout to be col for 16x16 matrix");
2905  }
2906  if (getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B8 &&
2907  getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B8X16_B4X16_P64 &&
2908  getEltType() != LdStMatrixEltType::B8X16_B6X16_P32) {
2909  return emitOpError("expected element type to be b8, b8x16.b4x16_p64 or "
2910  "b8x16.b6x16_p32 for 16x16 matrix");
2911  }
2912  } else {
2913  return emitOpError("expected shape to be 8x8, 8x16 or 16x16");
2914  }
2915 
2916  Type i32 = IntegerType::get(getContext(), 32);
2917  uint32_t numElements = (m == 16 && n == 16 ? num * 2 : num);
2918  if (numElements == 1 && getType() != i32)
2919  return emitOpError("expected destination type is i32");
2920  if (numElements == 2 || numElements == 4) {
2921  Type dstType = LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
2922  getContext(), SmallVector<Type>(numElements, i32));
2923  if (getType() != dstType)
2924  return emitOpError("expected destination type is a structure of ")
2925  << numElements << " elements of type i32";
2926  }
2927 
2928  return success();
2929 }

2983 static FailureOr<int> getAllowedSizeK(NVVM::WGMMATypes typeA) {
2984  if (typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::tf32)
2985  return 8;
2986  if (typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16 || typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::bf16)
2987  return 16;
2988  if (typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::s8 || typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::u8)
2989  return 32;
2990  if (typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::e4m3 || typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::e5m2)
2991  return 32;
2992  if (typeA == NVVM::WGMMATypes::b1)
2993  return 256;
2994  return failure();
2995 }
2996 
2997 static LogicalResult isAllowedWGMMADataType(NVVM::WGMMATypes typeD,
2998  NVVM::WGMMATypes typeA,
2999  NVVM::WGMMATypes typeB) {
3000  switch (typeA) {
3001  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16:
3002  if ((typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f32 || typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16) &&
3003  typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16)
3004  return success();
3005  break;
3006  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::tf32:
3007  if (typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f32 && typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::tf32)
3008  return success();
3009  break;
3010  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::u8:
3011  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::s8:
3012  if (typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::s32 &&
3013  (typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::u8 || typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::s8))
3014  return success();
3015  break;
3016  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::b1:
3017  if (typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::s32 && typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::b1)
3018  return success();
3019  break;
3020  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::bf16:
3021  if ((typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f32 || typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16) &&
3022  typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::bf16)
3023  return success();
3024  break;
3025  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::e4m3:
3026  case NVVM::WGMMATypes::e5m2:
3027  if ((typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f32 || typeD == NVVM::WGMMATypes::f16) &&
3028  (typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::e5m2 || typeB == NVVM::WGMMATypes::e4m3))
3029  return success();
3030  break;
3031  case WGMMATypes::f32:
3032  case WGMMATypes::s32:
3033  llvm_unreachable("unsupported input types");
3034  break;
3035  }
3036  return failure();
3037 }
3038 
3039 static LogicalResult isAllowedSizeN(int sizeN, NVVM::WGMMATypes typeA) {
3040  SmallVector<int> allowedN = {8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64,
3041  72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120, 128,
3042  136, 144, 152, 160, 168, 176, 184, 192,
3043  200, 208, 216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256};
3044  SmallVector<int> allowedNshort = {8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64,
3045  80, 96, 112, 128, 144, 160,
3046  176, 192, 208, 224, 240, 256};
3047  switch (typeA) {
3048  case WGMMATypes::f16:
3049  case WGMMATypes::tf32:
3050  case WGMMATypes::bf16:
3051  case WGMMATypes::e4m3:
3052  case WGMMATypes::e5m2:
3053  if (llvm::is_contained(allowedN, sizeN))
3054  return success();
3055  break;
3056  case WGMMATypes::u8:
3057  case WGMMATypes::s8:
3058  case WGMMATypes::b1:
3059  if (llvm::is_contained(allowedNshort, sizeN))
3060  return success();
3061  break;
3062  case WGMMATypes::f32:
3063  case WGMMATypes::s32:
3064  llvm_unreachable("unsupported input types");
3065  break;
3066  }
3067  return failure();
3068 }
3069 
3070 LogicalResult NVVM::WgmmaMmaAsyncOp::verify() {
3071  Value outValue = getResults();
3072  auto stype = dyn_cast<LLVM::LLVMStructType>(outValue.getType());
3073  if (!stype)
3074  return emitOpError() << "expected results to be struct";
3075  int outputSize = stype.getBody().size();
3076  WGMMATypes typeD = getTypeD();
3077  WGMMATypes typeA = getTypeA();
3078  WGMMATypes typeB = getTypeB();
3079 
3080  for (Type t : stype.getBody()) {
3081  if (t != stype.getBody().front())
3082  return emitOpError()
3083  << "all elements in struct must be same type but there is " << t;
3084  }
3085 
3086  if (typeD != WGMMATypes::f32 && typeD != WGMMATypes::f16 &&
3087  typeD != WGMMATypes::s32) {
3088  return emitOpError() << "does not support the given output type " << typeD;
3089  }
3090  if (typeD == WGMMATypes::s32 &&
3091  (getScaleA() == WGMMAScaleIn::neg || getScaleB() == WGMMAScaleIn::neg)) {
3092  return emitOpError() << "has s32 output, scaleA and scaleB cannot be neg";
3093  }
3094 
3095  if (failed(isAllowedWGMMADataType(typeD, typeA, typeB))) {
3096  return emitOpError() << typeD << " += " << typeA << " * " << typeB
3097  << ", it is not supported.";
3098  }
3099 
3100  // Check M
3101  if (getShape().getM() != 64)
3102  return emitOpError() << "shape 'm' must be 64";
3103 
3104  // Check K
3105  FailureOr<int> allowedK = getAllowedSizeK(typeA);
3106  if (failed(allowedK) || allowedK.value() != getShape().getK())
3107  return emitOpError() << "shape 'k' must be " << allowedK.value()
3108  << " for input type " << typeA;
3109 
3110  // Check N
3111  if (failed(isAllowedSizeN(getShape().getN(), typeA))) {
3112  return emitOpError() << "has input type " << typeA << " n is set to "
3113  << getShape().getN() << ", it is not supported.";
3114  }
3115 
3116  // Check transpose (only available for f16/bf16)
3117  // Matrices A should be stored in row-major and B in column-major.
3118  // Only f16/bf16 matrices can be stored in either column-major or row-major
3119  // by setting the transpose value(imm-trans-a,imm-trans-b) in PTX code.
3120  if ((typeA != WGMMATypes::f16 && typeA != WGMMATypes::bf16) &&
3121  (getLayoutA() == mlir::NVVM::MMALayout::col ||
3122  getLayoutB() == mlir::NVVM::MMALayout::row)) {
3123  return emitOpError()
3124  << "given layouts layout_a = " << getLayoutA()
3125  << " and layout_b = " << getLayoutB() << " for input types " << typeA
3126  << " and " << typeB
3127  << " requires transpose. However, this is only supported for: "
3128  << MMATypes::f16 << " and " << MMATypes::bf16;
3129  }
3130 
3131  // Check result registers
3132  int expectedOutput = 0;
3133  if (typeD == WGMMATypes::f32 || typeD == WGMMATypes::s32)
3134  expectedOutput = getShape().getN() / 2;
3135  if (typeD == WGMMATypes::f16)
3136  expectedOutput = getShape().getN() / 4;
3137  if (outputSize != expectedOutput) {
3138  return emitOpError() << "results " << expectedOutput
3139  << ", however output struct has " << outputSize
3140  << " elements";
3141  }
3142  // Check satfinite (only available for s32 accumulator)
3143  if (typeD != WGMMATypes::s32 &&
3144  getSatfinite().value_or(NVVM::MMAIntOverflow::wrapped) ==
3145  NVVM::MMAIntOverflow::satfinite) {
3146  return emitOpError()
3147  << " `satfinite` can be only used with s32 accumulator, however "
3148  "the current accumulator is "
3149  << typeD;
3150  }
3151 
3152  return success();
3153 }
3154 
3155 std::string NVVM::WgmmaMmaAsyncOp::getPtx() {
3156 
3157  int m = getShape().getM(), n = getShape().getN(), k = getShape().getK();
3158  bool isF16 = getTypeA() == WGMMATypes::f16 || getTypeA() == WGMMATypes::bf16;
3159 
3160  StringRef outputTypeName = stringifyWGMMATypes(getTypeD());
3161 
3162  int expectedOutputRegisters = 0;
3163  if (getTypeD() == WGMMATypes::f16)
3164  expectedOutputRegisters = getShape().getN() / 4;
3165  else
3166  expectedOutputRegisters = getShape().getN() / 2;
3167 
3168  std::string ptx;
3169  llvm::raw_string_ostream ss(ptx);
3170 
3171  ss << "{\n"
3172  ".reg .pred p;\n"
3173  "setp.ne.b32 p, $"
3174  << ((expectedOutputRegisters * 2) + 2)
3175  << ", 0;\n"
3176  "wgmma.mma_async.sync.aligned.m"
3177  << m << "n" << n << "k" << k << "." << outputTypeName << "." << getTypeA()
3178  << "." << getTypeB();
3179  if (getSatfinite().value_or(NVVM::MMAIntOverflow::wrapped) ==
3180  NVVM::MMAIntOverflow::satfinite)
3181  ss << ".satfinite";
3182  ss << " {";
3183  int regCnt = 0;
3184  for (; regCnt < expectedOutputRegisters; ++regCnt) {
3185  ss << "$" << regCnt;
3186  if (regCnt != expectedOutputRegisters - 1)
3187  ss << ", ";
3188  }
3189 
3190  ss << "},";
3191  // Need to map read/write registers correctly.
3192  regCnt = (regCnt * 2);
3193  ss << " $" << (regCnt) << "," << " $" << (regCnt + 1) << "," << " p";
3194  if (getTypeD() != WGMMATypes::s32) {
3195  ss << ", $" << (regCnt + 3) << ", $" << (regCnt + 4);
3196  }
3197  // Don't add transpose parameters unless needed.
3198  if (isF16) {
3199  ss << ", $" << (regCnt + 5) << ", $" << (regCnt + 6);
3200  }
3201  ss << ";\n"
3202  << "}\n";
3203  return ptx;
3204 }
3205 
3206 bool NVVM::WgmmaMmaAsyncOp::getAsmValues(
3207  RewriterBase &rewriter,
3208  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<std::pair<mlir::Value, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod>>
3209  &asmValues) {
3210  bool isF16 = getTypeA() == WGMMATypes::f16 || getTypeA() == WGMMATypes::bf16;
3211  if (getResults())
3212  asmValues.push_back({getResults(), mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Write});
3213  if (getInouts())
3214  asmValues.push_back({getInouts(), mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::ReadWrite});
3215  asmValues.push_back({getDescriptorA(), mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3216  asmValues.push_back({getDescriptorB(), mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3217  asmValues.push_back({makeConstantI32(rewriter, static_cast<int>(getScaleD())),
3218  mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3219  if (getTypeD() != WGMMATypes::s32) {
3220  asmValues.push_back(
3221  {makeConstantI32(rewriter,
3222  getScaleA() == NVVM::WGMMAScaleIn::neg ? -1 : 1),
3223  mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3224  asmValues.push_back(
3225  {makeConstantI32(rewriter,
3226  getScaleB() == NVVM::WGMMAScaleIn::neg ? -1 : 1),
3227  mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3228  }
3229  if (isF16) {
3230  asmValues.push_back(
3231  {makeConstantI32(rewriter, static_cast<int>(getLayoutA())),
3232  mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3233  asmValues.push_back(
3234  {makeConstantI32(rewriter, 1 - static_cast<int>(getLayoutB())),
3235  mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
3236  }
3237  return true; // Has manual mapping
3238 }

3261 LogicalResult NVVM::FenceProxyReleaseOp::verify() {

3289 LogicalResult NVVM::Tcgen05CpOp::verify() {
3290  auto mc = getMulticast();
3291 
3292  using SH = Tcgen05CpShape;
3293  using MC = Tcgen05CpMulticast;
3294  switch (getShape()) {
3295  case SH::SHAPE_128x256b:
3296  case SH::SHAPE_128x128b:
3297  case SH::SHAPE_4x256b:
3298  if (mc != MC::NONE)
3299  return emitError("Invalid multicast type for tcgen05.cp Op");
3300  break;
3301  case SH::SHAPE_64x128b:
3302  if (mc != MC::WARPX2_01_23 && mc != MC::WARPX2_02_13)
3303  return emitError("Shape 64x128b requires multicast warpx2_01_23 or "
3304  "warpx2_02_13 for tcgen05.cp Op");
3305  break;
3306  case SH::SHAPE_32x128b:
3307  if (mc != MC::WARPX4)
3308  return emitError(
3309  "Shape 32x128b requires multicast warpx4 for tcgen05.cp Op");
3310  break;
3311  }
3312  return success();
3313 }

3364 LogicalResult NVVM::PrefetchOp::verify() {
3365  using MemSpace = NVVM::NVVMMemorySpace;
3366  using CacheLevel = NVVM::PrefetchCacheLevel;
3367 
3368  unsigned addressSpace =
3369  llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(getAddr().getType()).getAddressSpace();
3370  std::optional<NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority> evictPriority = getEvictPriority();
3371  std::optional<NVVM::PrefetchCacheLevel> cacheLevel = getCacheLevel();
3372 
3373  if (getTensormap() && cacheLevel)
3374  return emitOpError("cannot specify both tensormap and cache level");
3375 
3376  if (getTensormap()) {
3377  if (addressSpace != MemSpace::Generic &&
3378  addressSpace != MemSpace::Constant) {
3379  return emitOpError(
3380  "prefetch tensormap requires a generic or constant pointer");
3381  }
3382 
3383  if (evictPriority) {
3384  return emitOpError(
3385  "prefetch tensormap does not support eviction priority");
3386  }
3387 
3388  if (getInParamSpace() && addressSpace != MemSpace::Generic) {
3389  return emitOpError(
3390  "in_param_space can only be specified for a generic pointer");
3391  }
3392 
3393  } else if (cacheLevel) {
3394  if (addressSpace != MemSpace::Generic && addressSpace != MemSpace::Global &&
3395  addressSpace != MemSpace::Local) {
3396  return emitOpError("prefetch to cache level requires a generic, global, "
3397  "or local pointer");
3398  }
3399 
3400  if (getUniform()) {
3401  if (*cacheLevel != CacheLevel::L1) {
3402  return emitOpError(
3403  "unsupported cache level, the only supported uniform "
3404  "cache level is L1");
3405  }
3406 
3407  if (addressSpace != MemSpace::Generic) {
3408  return emitOpError(
3409  "prefetch to uniform cache requires a generic pointer");
3410  }
3411  }
3412 
3413  if (evictPriority) {
3414  if (*cacheLevel != CacheLevel::L2)
3415  return emitOpError(
3416  "cache eviction priority supported only for cache level L2");
3417 
3418  if (addressSpace != MemSpace::Global)
3419  return emitOpError("cache eviction priority requires a global pointer");
3420 
3421  if (*evictPriority != NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority::EvictNormal &&
3422  *evictPriority != NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority::EvictLast)
3423  return emitOpError(
3424  "unsupported cache eviction priority, only evict_last and "
3425  "evict_normal are supported");
3426  }
3427 
3428  if (getPredicate())
3429  return emitOpError("predicate supported only on prefetch tensormap");
3430 
3431  } else {
3432  return emitOpError(
3433  "requires specification of either cache level or tensormap");
3434  }
3435 
3436  return success();
3437 }

3469 LogicalResult NVVM::ReduxOp::verify() {

3475  if (getNan())

3489  if (!reduxType.isInteger(32))

3492  << " type. Only supported type is 'i32'.";
3493  break;
3494  case NVVM::ReductionKind::FMIN:
3495  case NVVM::ReductionKind::FMAX:

3497  return emitOpError("'")
3498  << kind << "' reduction kind unsupported with " << reduxType
3499  << " type. Only supported type is 'f32'.";
3500  break;
3501  }
3502 
3503  return success();
3504 }

3506 LogicalResult NVVM::TensormapReplaceOp::verify() {
3507  auto ord = getOrd();
3508  Value newVal = getNewValue();
3509  auto newValAttr = getNewValueAttr();
3510  auto fieldName = stringifyEnum(getField());
3511 
3512  if (ord && !llvm::is_contained({NVVM::TensormapField::BOX_DIM,
3513  NVVM::TensormapField::GLOBAL_DIM,
3514  NVVM::TensormapField::GLOBAL_STRIDE,
3515  NVVM::TensormapField::ELEMENT_STRIDE},
3516  getField()))
3517  return emitOpError("ordinal is not supported for ")
3518  << fieldName << " field";
3519 
3520  auto invalidNewVal = [&](llvm::Twine type) -> std::string {
3521  return llvm::Twine("new_value must be specified and must be an " + type +
3522  " for " + llvm::Twine(fieldName) + " field")
3523  .str();
3524  };
3525 
3526  auto invalidNewValAttr = [&]() -> std::string {
3527  return (llvm::Twine(
3528  "new_value_attr must be specified and must be a valid ") +
3529  llvm::Twine(fieldName) + " attribute for " + fieldName + " field")
3530  .str();
3531  };
3532 
3533  switch (getField()) {
3534  case NVVM::TensormapField::GLOBAL_ADDRESS:
3535  if (!(newVal && newVal.getType().isInteger(64)))
3536  return emitOpError(invalidNewVal("i64"));
3537  break;
3538  case NVVM::TensormapField::RANK:
3539  if (!(newVal && newVal.getType().isInteger(32)))
3540  return emitOpError(invalidNewVal("i32"));
3541  break;
3542  case NVVM::TensormapField::GLOBAL_STRIDE:
3543  if (!ord)
3544  return emitOpError("ordinal is required for global_stride field");
3545  if (!(newVal && newVal.getType().isInteger(64)))
3546  return emitOpError(invalidNewVal("i64"));
3547  break;
3548  case NVVM::TensormapField::BOX_DIM:
3549  case NVVM::TensormapField::GLOBAL_DIM:
3550  case NVVM::TensormapField::ELEMENT_STRIDE:
3551  if (!ord)
3552  return emitOpError("ordinal is required for ")
3553  << stringifyEnum(getField()) << " field";
3554  if (!(newVal && newVal.getType().isInteger(32)))
3555  return emitOpError(invalidNewVal("i32"));
3556  break;
3557  case NVVM::TensormapField::ELEMTYPE:
3558  if (!(newValAttr && llvm::isa<TensormapElemtypeAttr>(*newValAttr)))
3559  return emitOpError(invalidNewValAttr());
3560  break;
3561  case NVVM::TensormapField::INTERLEAVE_LAYOUT:
3562  if (!(newValAttr && llvm::isa<TensormapInterleaveLayoutAttr>(*newValAttr)))
3563  return emitOpError(invalidNewValAttr());
3564  break;
3565  case NVVM::TensormapField::SWIZZLE_MODE:
3566  if (!(newValAttr && llvm::isa<TensormapSwizzleModeAttr>(*newValAttr)))
3567  return emitOpError(invalidNewValAttr());
3568  break;
3569  case NVVM::TensormapField::SWIZZLE_ATOMICITY:
3570  if (!(newValAttr && llvm::isa<TensormapSwizzleAtomicityAttr>(*newValAttr)))
3571  return emitOpError(invalidNewValAttr());
3572  break;
3573  case NVVM::TensormapField::FILL_MODE:
3574  if (!(newValAttr && llvm::isa<TensormapFillModeAttr>(*newValAttr)))
3575  return emitOpError(invalidNewValAttr());
3576  break;
3577  }
3578 
3579  return success();
3580 }

3582 template <typename OpType>
3583 static LogicalResult verifyAddSubFOp(OpType op) {
3584  mlir::NVVM::FPRoundingMode rndMode = op.getRnd();
3585  mlir::NVVM::SaturationMode satMode = op.getSat();
3586  bool isFTZ = op.getFtz();
3587 
3588  mlir::Type opType = op.getRes().getType();
3589  mlir::Type opBaseType = isa<VectorType>(opType)
3590  ? cast<VectorType>(opType).getElementType()
3591  : opType;
3592 
3593  if (opBaseType.isF64() && (satMode != NVVM::SaturationMode::NONE || isFTZ))
3594  return op.emitOpError("FTZ and saturation are not supported for "
3595  "additions/subtractions involving f64 type");
3596 
3597  if (opBaseType.isF16() && !(rndMode == NVVM::FPRoundingMode::RN ||
3598  rndMode == NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE))
3599  return op.emitOpError("only RN rounding mode is supported for f16 and "
3600  "vector<2xf16> additions/subtractions");
3601 
3602  if (opBaseType.isBF16()) {
3603  if (rndMode != NVVM::FPRoundingMode::RN &&
3604  rndMode != NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE)
3605  return op.emitOpError("only RN rounding mode is supported for bf16 and "
3606  "vector<2xbf16> additions/subtractions");
3607  if (satMode != NVVM::SaturationMode::NONE || isFTZ)
3608  return op.emitOpError("FTZ and saturation are not supported for bf16 and "
3609  "vector<2xbf16> additions/subtractions");
3610  }
3611 
3612  // FIXME: This is a temporary check disallowing lowering to add.rn.ftz.f16(x2)
3613  // PTX instructions since the corresponding LLVM intrinsic is missing. This
3614  // should be removed once the intrinsics for f16 addition (with FTZ only) are
3615  // available.
3616  if (opBaseType.isF16() && isFTZ && satMode == NVVM::SaturationMode::NONE)
3617  return op.emitOpError("FTZ with no saturation is not supported for f16 and "
3618  "vector<2xf16> additions/subtractions");
3619 
3620  return success();
3621 }
3622 
3623 LogicalResult NVVM::AddFOp::verify() { return verifyAddSubFOp<AddFOp>(*this); }
3624 
3625 LogicalResult NVVM::SubFOp::verify() { return verifyAddSubFOp<SubFOp>(*this); }

3627 LogicalResult NVVM::FmaOp::verify() {
3628  auto opType = getRes().getType();
3629  mlir::NVVM::FPRoundingMode rndMode = getRnd();
3630  mlir::NVVM::SaturationMode satMode = getSat();
3631  bool isFTZ = getFtz();
3632  bool isRelu = getRelu();
3633  bool hasOOB = getOob();
3634 
3635  auto getBaseFType = [](Type type) -> Type {
3636  if (isa<VectorType>(type))
3637  return cast<VectorType>(type).getElementType();
3638  return type;
3639  };
3640 
3641  auto opBaseType = getBaseFType(opType);
3642 
3643  if (rndMode == NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE)
3644  return emitOpError("rounding mode must be specified");
3645 
3646  if (isRelu && satMode == NVVM::SaturationMode::SAT)
3647  return emitOpError("relu and saturation are not supported together");
3648 
3649  if (hasOOB && (satMode == NVVM::SaturationMode::SAT || isFTZ))
3650  return emitOpError("oob is not supported with saturation or FTZ");
3651 
3652  if (!(opBaseType.isF16() || opBaseType.isBF16()) && (isRelu || hasOOB))
3653  return emitOpError("relu and oob are only supported for f16 and bf16");
3654 
3655  if (opBaseType.isF64() && (satMode != NVVM::SaturationMode::NONE || isFTZ))
3656  return emitOpError("FTZ and saturation are not supported for f64 type");
3657 
3658  if (opBaseType.isF16() && rndMode != NVVM::FPRoundingMode::RN)
3659  return emitOpError(
3660  "only RN rounding mode is supported for f16 and vector<2xf16>");
3661 
3662  if (opBaseType.isBF16()) {
3663  if (rndMode != NVVM::FPRoundingMode::RN)
3664  return emitOpError(
3665  "only RN rounding mode is supported for bf16 and vector<2xbf16>");
3666  if (satMode != NVVM::SaturationMode::NONE || isFTZ)
3667  return emitOpError(
3668  "FTZ and saturation are not supported for bf16 and vector<2xbf16>");
3669  }
3670 
3671  return success();
3672 }

3674 LogicalResult NVVM::SqrtOp::verify() {
3675  if (getRnd() == NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE)

3684 LogicalResult NVVM::DivFOp::verify() {
3685  bool isApprox = getApprox();
3686  bool isFull = getFull();
3687  bool isF64 = getRes().getType().isF64();
3688  bool isFtz = getFtz();
3689  NVVM::FPRoundingMode rndMode = getRnd();
3690 
3691  if (isApprox && isFull)
3692  return emitOpError("'approx' and 'full' are mutually exclusive");
3693 
3694  if (isApprox || isFull) {
3695  if (isF64)
3696  return emitOpError("'approx' and 'full' forms are f32-only");
3697  if (rndMode != NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE)
3698  return emitOpError(
3699  "'approx' and 'full' forms do not accept a rounding mode");
3700  return success();
3701  }
3702 
3703  // Rounded form below.
3704  if (rndMode == NVVM::FPRoundingMode::NONE)
3705  return emitOpError("rounding mode cannot be None for the rounded divide");
3706  if (isF64 && isFtz)
3707  return emitOpError("FTZ is not supported for f64");
3708 
3709  return success();
3710 }

3712 /// Packs the given `field` into the `result`.
3713 /// The `result` is 64-bits and each `field` can be 32-bits or narrower.
3714 static llvm::Value *
3715 packValInto64Bits(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
3716  llvm::Value *result, // the `result` (unset bits are zero)
3717  llvm::Value *field, // `field` to pack into `result`
3718  unsigned sizeInBits, // Size of `field` in bits
3719  unsigned start) { // Starting bit within `result`
3720  field = builder.CreateZExtOrBitCast(field, builder.getInt32Ty());
3721 
3722  unsigned mask = (sizeInBits < 32 ? ((1u << sizeInBits) - 1) : 0xffffffffu);
3723  if (mask != 0xffffffffu)
3724  field = builder.CreateAnd(field, builder.getInt32(mask));
3725 
3726  field = builder.CreateZExtOrBitCast(field, builder.getInt64Ty());
3727  field = builder.CreateShl(field, start);
3728 
3729  return builder.CreateOr(result, field);
3730 }

3732 void Tcgen05MmaSmemDescOp::createSmemDescriptor(Operation &op,
3733  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
3734  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
3735  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::Tcgen05MmaSmemDescOp>(op);
3736  llvm::Value *smemDesc = builder.getInt64(0);
3737 
3738  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(builder, smemDesc,
3739  mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getStartAddr()), 14, 0);
3740  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(
3741  builder, smemDesc, mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getLeadingDimOffset()), 14, 16);
3742  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(
3743  builder, smemDesc, mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getStrideDimOffset()), 14, 32);
3744 
3745  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(builder, smemDesc, builder.getInt32(1), 3, 46);
3746  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(builder, smemDesc,
3747  mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getBaseOffset()), 3, 49);
3748  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(
3749  builder, smemDesc, mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getLeadingDimMode()), 1, 52);
3750  smemDesc = packValInto64Bits(builder, smemDesc,
3751  mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSwizzleMode()), 3, 61);
3752 
3753  mt.mapValue(thisOp.getRes()) = smemDesc;
3754 }

3792 struct ConvertFsubToFnegFadd : public OpRewritePattern<SubFOp> {
3793  using OpRewritePattern<SubFOp>::OpRewritePattern;
3794 
3795  LogicalResult matchAndRewrite(SubFOp op,
3796  PatternRewriter &rewriter) const override {
3797  Location loc = op.getLoc();
3798  Value negRhs =
3799  LLVM::FNegOp::create(rewriter, loc, op.getRhs().getType(), op.getRhs());
3800 
3801  rewriter.replaceOpWithNewOp<AddFOp>(op, op.getType(), op.getLhs(), negRhs,
3802  op.getRnd(), op.getSat(), op.getFtz());
3803  return success();
3804  }
3805 };
3806 
3807 void SubFOp::getCanonicalizationPatterns(RewritePatternSet &patterns,
3808  MLIRContext *context) {
3809  patterns.add<ConvertFsubToFnegFadd>(context);
3810 }

3816 /// Maps the (aligned, hasCount) pair to the `@llvm.nvvm.barrier.cta.sync.*`

3822  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_sync_count;
3823  }
3824  return aligned ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_sync_aligned_all
3825  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_sync_all;
3826 }
3827 
3828 /// Maps the (aligned, kind) pair to the `@llvm.nvvm.barrier.cta.red.*`
3829 /// intrinsic ID.
3830 static llvm::Intrinsic::ID
3831 getBarrierReductionIntrinsic(bool aligned, NVVM::BarrierReduction kind) {
3832  switch (kind) {
3833  case NVVM::BarrierReduction::AND:
3834  return aligned ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_and_aligned_all
3835  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_and_all;
3836  case NVVM::BarrierReduction::OR:
3837  return aligned ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_or_aligned_all
3838  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_or_all;
3839  case NVVM::BarrierReduction::POPC:
3840  return aligned ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_popc_aligned_all
3841  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_barrier_cta_red_popc_all;
3842  }
3843  llvm_unreachable("unknown BarrierReduction kind");
3844 }

3846 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair NVVM::BarrierOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
3847  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
3848  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::BarrierOp>(op);
3849  llvm::Value *barrierId = thisOp.getBarrierId()
3850  ? mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getBarrierId())
3851  : builder.getInt32(0);
3852  bool hasCount = static_cast<bool>(thisOp.getNumberOfThreads());
3853  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id =
3854  getBarrierSyncIntrinsic(thisOp.getAligned(), hasCount);
3855  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args = {barrierId};
3856  if (hasCount)
3857  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getNumberOfThreads()));
3858  return {id, std::move(args)};
3859 }

3950 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
3951 SqrtOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
3952  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
3953  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::SqrtOp>(op);
3954  Type t = thisOp.getRes().getType();
3955  NVVM::FPRoundingMode rndMode = thisOp.getRnd();
3956  bool isFtz = thisOp.getFtz();
3957 
3958  // RM is one of RN/RM/RP/RZ (verifier rejects NONE).
3959  // Subtracting 1 maps RN=1..RZ=4 to 0..3.
3960  unsigned rndIndex = static_cast<unsigned>(rndMode) - 1;
3961 
3962  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f32IDs[] = {
3963  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rn_f,
3964  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rm_f,
3965  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rp_f,
3966  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rz_f,
3967  };
3968  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f32FTZIDs[] = {
3969  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rn_ftz_f,
3970  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rm_ftz_f,
3971  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rp_ftz_f,
3972  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rz_ftz_f,
3973  };
3974  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f64IDs[] = {
3975  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rn_d,
3976  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rm_d,
3977  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rp_d,
3978  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_sqrt_rz_d,
3979  };
3980 
3981  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id =
3982  t.isF32() ? (isFtz ? f32FTZIDs[rndIndex] : f32IDs[rndIndex])
3983  : f64IDs[rndIndex];
3984 
3985  return {id, {mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSrc())}};
3986 }

3998 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
3999 DivFOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
4000  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4001  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::DivFOp>(op);
4002  bool isFtz = thisOp.getFtz();
4003 
4004  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id;
4005 
4006  if (thisOp.getApprox()) {
4007  id = isFtz ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_approx_ftz_f
4008  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_approx_f;
4009  } else if (thisOp.getFull()) {
4010  // Intrinsic Naming quirk: int_nvvm_div_full has no `_f` suffix (unlike
4011  // approx).
4012  id = isFtz ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_full_ftz
4013  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_full;
4014  } else {
4015  // Rounded form — three 4-entry tables indexed by (rndMode - 1).
4016  unsigned rndIndex = static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getRnd()) - 1;
4017 
4018  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f32IDs[] = {
4019  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rn_f,
4020  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rm_f,
4021  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rp_f,
4022  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rz_f,
4023  };
4024  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f32FTZIDs[] = {
4025  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rn_ftz_f,
4026  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rm_ftz_f,
4027  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rp_ftz_f,
4028  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rz_ftz_f,
4029  };
4030  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID f64IDs[] = {
4031  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rn_d,
4032  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rm_d,
4033  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rp_d,
4034  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_div_rz_d,
4035  };
4036  Type t = thisOp.getRes().getType();
4037  id = t.isF32() ? (isFtz ? f32FTZIDs[rndIndex] : f32IDs[rndIndex])
4038  : f64IDs[rndIndex];
4039  }
4040 
4041  return {id,
4042  {mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getLhs()), mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getRhs())}};
4043 }

4045 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair AsyncStoreGlobalOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
4046  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4047  using IDArgPair = mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair;
4048  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::AsyncStoreGlobalOp>(op);
4049  mlir::NVVM::MemScopeKind scope = thisOp.getScope();
4050  bool isMmio = thisOp.getMmio();
4051 
4052  llvm::Value *addr = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getAddr());
4053  llvm::Value *value = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getValue());
4054  llvm::Value *isMultimem = builder.getInt1(thisOp.getMultimem());
4055 
4056  if (scope == MemScopeKind::SYS) {
4057  return isMmio ? IDArgPair(llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_st_async_mmio_sys,
4058  {addr, value})
4059  : IDArgPair(llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_st_async_sys,
4060  {addr, value, isMultimem});
4061  } else if (scope == MemScopeKind::GPU) {
4062  return IDArgPair(llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_st_async_gpu,
4063  {addr, value, isMultimem});
4064  }
4065  llvm_unreachable("unsupported scope for AsyncStoreGlobalOp");
4066 }

4068 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
4069 PMEventOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
4070  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {

4072  llvm::Type *i16Ty = llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(mt.getLLVMContext());
4073 
4074  // With event-id, mask is generated as (1 << event-id)
4075  llvm::Value *maskVal;
4076  if (auto eventAttr = thisOp.getEventIdAttr()) {
4077  uint16_t mask = static_cast<uint16_t>(1u << eventAttr.getInt());
4078  maskVal = llvm::ConstantInt::get(i16Ty, mask);

4080  maskVal =
4081  llvm::ConstantInt::get(i16Ty, thisOp.getMaskedEventIdAttr().getValue());
4082  }
4083 
4084  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_pm_event_mask, {maskVal}};
4085 }

4118  bool isClusterScope = thisOp.getScope() == NVVM::MemScopeKind::CLUSTER;
4119  // bit-0: Space
4120  // bit-1: Scope
4121  size_t index = ((isClusterScope ? 1 : 0) << 1) | (isClusterSpace ? 1 : 0);

4123  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID IDs[] = {
4124  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_expect_tx_scope_cta_space_cta,
4125  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_expect_tx_scope_cta_space_cluster,
4126  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_expect_tx_scope_cluster_space_cta,
4127  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_expect_tx_scope_cluster_space_cluster};
4128 
4129  // Fill the Intrinsic Args
4130  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
4131  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getAddr()));
4132  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getTxcount()));
4133 
4134  return {IDs[index], std::move(args)};
4135 }

4161 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair MBarrierArriveOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
4162  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4163  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::MBarrierArriveOp>(op);
4164 
4165  bool isClusterSpace = isPtrInSharedClusterSpace(thisOp.getAddr());
4166  bool isClusterScope = thisOp.getScope() == NVVM::MemScopeKind::CLUSTER;
4167  // bit-0: Space
4168  // bit-1: Scope
4169  size_t index = ((isClusterScope ? 1 : 0) << 1) | (isClusterSpace ? 1 : 0);
4170 
4171  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID IDs[] = {
4172  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_scope_cta_space_cta,
4173  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_scope_cta_space_cluster,
4174  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_scope_cluster_space_cta,
4175  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_scope_cluster_space_cluster};
4176  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID relaxedIDs[] = {
4177  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_relaxed_scope_cta_space_cta,
4178  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_relaxed_scope_cta_space_cluster,
4179  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_relaxed_scope_cluster_space_cta,
4180  llvm::Intrinsic::
4181  nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_relaxed_scope_cluster_space_cluster};
4182  auto id = thisOp.getRelaxed() ? relaxedIDs[index] : IDs[index];
4183 
4184  // Tidy-up the Intrinsic Args
4185  bool needCast = isPtrInGenericSpace(thisOp.getAddr());
4186  llvm::Value *mbar = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getAddr());
4187  if (needCast)
4188  mbar = castPtrToAddrSpace(builder, mbar, NVVMMemorySpace::Shared);
4189 
4190  // We have the most basic mbarrier.arrive supported on sm_80.
4191  // It supports: Space=cta, scope=cta, No relaxed, No explicit count.
4192  // So, only for this combination use the legacy intrinsic.
4193  bool hasCount = static_cast<bool>(thisOp.getCount());
4194  if (!hasCount &&
4195  (id == llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_scope_cta_space_cta))
4196  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_mbarrier_arrive_shared, {mbar}};
4197 
4198  // When count is not explicitly specified, the default is 1.
4199  llvm::LLVMContext &ctx = mt.getLLVMContext();
4200  llvm::Value *count =
4201  hasCount ? mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getCount())
4202  : llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 1);
4203  return {id, {mbar, count}};
4204 }

4466 #define CP_ASYNC_ID_IMPL(mod, size, suffix) \
4467  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_##mod##_shared_global_##size##suffix
4468 
4469 #define GET_CP_ASYNC_ID(mod, size, has_cpsize) \
4470  has_cpsize ? CP_ASYNC_ID_IMPL(mod, size, _s) : CP_ASYNC_ID_IMPL(mod, size, )

4472 llvm::Intrinsic::ID
4473 CpAsyncOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
4474  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> &args) {
4475  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id;
4476 
4477  auto cpAsyncOp = cast<NVVM::CpAsyncOp>(op);
4478  bool hasCpSize = static_cast<bool>(cpAsyncOp.getCpSize());
4479  switch (cpAsyncOp.getSize()) {
4480  case 4:
4481  id = GET_CP_ASYNC_ID(ca, 4, hasCpSize);
4482  break;
4483  case 8:
4484  id = GET_CP_ASYNC_ID(ca, 8, hasCpSize);
4485  break;
4486  case 16:
4487  id = (cpAsyncOp.getModifier() == NVVM::LoadCacheModifierKind::CG)
4488  ? GET_CP_ASYNC_ID(cg, 16, hasCpSize)
4489  : GET_CP_ASYNC_ID(ca, 16, hasCpSize);
4490  break;
4491  default:
4492  llvm_unreachable("Invalid copy size in CpAsyncOp.");
4493  }
4494 
4495  // Fill the Intrinsic Args
4496  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(cpAsyncOp.getDst()));
4497  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(cpAsyncOp.getSrc()));
4498  if (hasCpSize)
4499  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(cpAsyncOp.getCpSize()));
4500 
4501  return id;
4502 }

4504 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair CpAsyncBulkPrefetchOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(

4514  mlir::Value cacheHint = thisOp.getL2CacheHint();
4515  const bool hasCacheHint = static_cast<bool>(cacheHint);

4519  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasCacheHint));

4521  return {id, std::move(args)};

4524 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair CpAsyncBulkGlobalToSharedClusterOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
4525  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4526  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::CpAsyncBulkGlobalToSharedClusterOp>(op);
4527  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
4528 
4529  // Fill the Intrinsic Args: dst, mbar, src, size.
4530  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDstMem()));
4531  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMbar()));
4532  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSrcMem()));
4533  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSize()));
4534 
4535  // Multicast mask for shared::cluster only, if available.
4536  mlir::Value multicastMask = thisOp.getMulticastMask();
4537  const bool hasMulticastMask = static_cast<bool>(multicastMask);
4538  const bool isSharedCTA = isPtrInSharedCTASpace(thisOp.getDstMem());
4539  if (!isSharedCTA) {
4540  llvm::Value *i16Unused = llvm::ConstantInt::get(builder.getInt16Ty(), 0);
4541  args.push_back(hasMulticastMask ? mt.lookupValue(multicastMask)
4542  : i16Unused);
4543  }
4544 
4545  // Cache hint, if available.
4546  mlir::Value cacheHint = thisOp.getL2CacheHint();
4547  const bool hasCacheHint = static_cast<bool>(cacheHint);
4548  llvm::Value *i64Unused = llvm::ConstantInt::get(builder.getInt64Ty(), 0);
4549  args.push_back(hasCacheHint ? mt.lookupValue(cacheHint) : i64Unused);
4550 
4551  // Flag arguments for multicast and cachehint.
4552  if (!isSharedCTA)
4553  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasMulticastMask));
4554  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasCacheHint));
4555 
4556  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id =
4557  isSharedCTA
4558  ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_global_to_shared_cta
4559  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_global_to_shared_cluster;
4560 
4561  return {id, std::move(args)};
4562 }

4564 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair CpAsyncBulkSharedCTAToGlobalOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
4565  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4566  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::CpAsyncBulkSharedCTAToGlobalOp>(op);
4567  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;

4569  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_shared_cta_to_global;

4572  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDstMem()));
4573  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSrcMem()));
4574  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSize()));
4575 
4576  mlir::Value cacheHint = thisOp.getL2CacheHint();
4577  const bool hasCacheHint = static_cast<bool>(cacheHint);
4578  llvm::Value *i64Unused =
4579  llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(mt.getLLVMContext()), 0);
4580  args.push_back(hasCacheHint ? mt.lookupValue(cacheHint) : i64Unused);
4581  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasCacheHint));

4588 
4589  return {id, std::move(args)};
4590 }

4593  RewriterBase &rewriter,
4594  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<std::pair<mlir::Value, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod>>
4595  &asmValues) {

4605 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
4606 CpAsyncBulkTensorGlobalToSharedClusterOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
4607  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
4608  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::CpAsyncBulkTensorGlobalToSharedClusterOp>(op);
4609  const bool isCTAOnly = thisOp.getIsCTAOnly();
4610  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
4611 
4612  // Fill the Intrinsic Args
4613  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDstMem()));
4614  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMbar()));
4615  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getTmaDescriptor()));
4616 
4617  // Coordinates and im2col-offsets
4618  for (mlir::Value v : thisOp.getCoordinates())
4619  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(v));
4620  for (mlir::Value v : thisOp.getIm2colOffsets())
4621  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(v));
4622 
4623  // MulticastMask, if available
4624  mlir::Value mcMask = thisOp.getMulticastMask();
4625  const bool hasMC = static_cast<bool>(mcMask);
4626  llvm::Value *i16Zero =
4627  llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(mt.getLLVMContext()), 0);
4628 
4629  // CacheHint, if available
4630  mlir::Value cacheHint = thisOp.getL2CacheHint();
4631  const bool hasCacheHint = static_cast<bool>(cacheHint);
4632  llvm::Value *i64Zero =
4633  llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(mt.getLLVMContext()), 0);
4634 
4635  // Flag argument CTAGroup
4636  // CTA_1/2 is mapped to values 1 and 2 for the intrinsics.
4637  // Hence, the +1 to getGroup().
4638  const int32_t val =
4639  thisOp.getGroup() ? (static_cast<int32_t>(*thisOp.getGroup()) + 1) : 0;
4640  llvm::Value *cg =
4641  llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(mt.getLLVMContext()), val);
4642 
4643  if (!isCTAOnly) {
4644  // For shared::cluster, all the arguments that we build are applicable.
4645  args.push_back(hasMC ? mt.lookupValue(mcMask) : i16Zero);
4646  args.push_back(hasCacheHint ? mt.lookupValue(cacheHint) : i64Zero);
4647  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasMC));
4648  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasCacheHint));
4649  args.push_back(cg);
4650  } else {
4651  // For shared::cta, only cache-hint is applicable.
4652  args.push_back(hasCacheHint ? mt.lookupValue(cacheHint) : i64Zero);
4653  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(hasCacheHint));
4654  }

4670  {notIntrinsic, notIntrinsic, notIntrinsic,

4672  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_tensor_g2s_im2col_w_4d,
4673  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_tensor_g2s_im2col_w_5d},

4676  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_cp_async_bulk_tensor_g2s_im2col_w_128_4d,

5497  unsigned idx = (hasSat << 1) | hasRelu;
5498 
5499  // Fill the Intrinsic Args
5500  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
5501  llvm::Value *packedI16 =
5502  builder.CreateBitCast(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getSrc()),
5503  llvm::Type::getInt16Ty(builder.getContext()));
5504  args.push_back(packedI16);
5505  args.push_back(hasScale ? mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getScaleFactor())
5506  : builder.getInt16(0x7f7f));
5507 
5508  return {ids[idx], std::move(args)};
5509 }

5545 llvm::Intrinsic::ID
5546 Tcgen05CommitOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op,
5547  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
5548  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> &args) {
5549  auto curOp = cast<NVVM::Tcgen05CommitOp>(op);
5550  bool hasMulticast = static_cast<bool>(curOp.getMulticastMask());
5551  bool is2CTAMode = curOp.getGroup() == CTAGroupKind::CTA_2;
5552  bool hasSmemARead = curOp.getSmemARead();
5553  unsigned index = (static_cast<unsigned>(hasSmemARead) << 1) |
5554  static_cast<unsigned>(is2CTAMode);
5555 
5556  using namespace llvm::Intrinsic;
5557  static constexpr ID IDs[] = {
5558  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_cg1,
5559  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_cg2,
5560  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_smem_a_read_cg1,
5561  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_smem_a_read_cg2,
5562  };
5563 
5564  static constexpr ID multicastIDs[] = {
5565  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_mc_cg1,
5566  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_mc_cg2,
5567  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_smem_a_read_mc_cg1,
5568  nvvm_tcgen05_commit_smem_a_read_mc_cg2,
5569  };
5570 
5571  ID id = hasMulticast ? multicastIDs[index] : IDs[index];
5572  // Fill the Intrinsic Args
5573  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(curOp.getAddr()));
5574  if (hasMulticast)
5575  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(curOp.getMulticastMask()));
5576 
5577  return id;
5578 }

5580 #define TCGEN05_CP_IMPL(shape_mc, src_fmt, cg) \
5581  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_cp##shape_mc##src_fmt##cg
5582 
5583 #define TCGEN05_CP_2CTA(shape_mc, src_fmt, is_2cta) \
5584  is_2cta ? TCGEN05_CP_IMPL(shape_mc, src_fmt, _cg2) \
5585  : TCGEN05_CP_IMPL(shape_mc, src_fmt, _cg1)
5586 
5587 #define GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(shape_mc, src_fmt, is_2cta) \
5588  [&]() -> auto { \
5589  if ((src_fmt) == Tcgen05CpSrcFormat::B6x16_P32) \
5590  return TCGEN05_CP_2CTA(shape_mc, _b6x16_p32, is_2cta); \
5591  if ((src_fmt) == Tcgen05CpSrcFormat::B4x16_P64) \
5592  return TCGEN05_CP_2CTA(shape_mc, _b4x16_p64, is_2cta); \
5593  return TCGEN05_CP_2CTA(shape_mc, , is_2cta); \
5594  }()

5596 NVVM::IDArgPair
5597 ConvertF32x2ToF16x2Op::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(NVVM::ConvertF32x2ToF16x2Op &op,
5598  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
5599  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
5600  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID rndRNIds[] = {
5601  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rn,
5602  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rn_relu,
5603  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rn_satfinite,
5604  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rn_relu_satfinite,
5605  };
5606  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID rndRZIds[] = {
5607  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rz,
5608  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rz_relu,
5609  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rz_satfinite,
5610  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rz_relu_satfinite,
5611  };
5612  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID rndRSIds[] = {
5613  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rs,
5614  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rs_relu,
5615  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rs_satfinite,
5616  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_ff2f16x2_rs_relu_satfinite,
5617  };
5618 
5619  unsigned hasRelu = op.getRelu() ? 1 : 0;
5620  unsigned hasSatFinite =
5621  (op.getSat() == NVVM::SaturationMode::SATFINITE) ? 1 : 0;
5622  // idx: bit-0 - relu
5623  // bit-1 - satfinite
5624  unsigned idx = (hasSatFinite << 1) | hasRelu;
5625 
5626  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
5627  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(op.getSrcHi()));
5628  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(op.getSrcLo()));
5629  if (op.getRandomBits())
5630  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(op.getRandomBits()));
5631 
5632  // TODO: Add support for PZO modifier
5633  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(false));
5634 
5635  switch (op.getRnd()) {
5636  case FPRoundingMode::RN:
5637  return {rndRNIds[idx], std::move(args)};
5638  case FPRoundingMode::RZ:
5639  return {rndRZIds[idx], std::move(args)};
5640  case FPRoundingMode::RS:
5641  return {rndRSIds[idx], std::move(args)};
5642  default:
5643  llvm_unreachable("Invalid rounding mode for ConvertF32x2ToF16x2Op");
5644  }
5645 }

5751 llvm::Intrinsic::ID Tcgen05CpOp::getIntrinsicID(Operation &op) {
5752  auto curOp = cast<NVVM::Tcgen05CpOp>(op);
5753  bool is2CTA = curOp.getGroup() == CTAGroupKind::CTA_2;
5754  auto srcFmt = curOp.getSrcFormat();
5755  auto mc = curOp.getMulticast();
5756 
5757  switch (curOp.getShape()) {
5758  case Tcgen05CpShape::SHAPE_128x256b:
5759  return GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_128x256b, srcFmt, is2CTA);
5760  case Tcgen05CpShape::SHAPE_128x128b:
5761  return GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_128x128b, srcFmt, is2CTA);
5762  case Tcgen05CpShape::SHAPE_4x256b:
5763  return GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_4x256b, srcFmt, is2CTA);
5764  case Tcgen05CpShape::SHAPE_32x128b:
5765  return GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_32x128b_warpx4, srcFmt, is2CTA);
5766  case Tcgen05CpShape::SHAPE_64x128b:
5767  return (mc == Tcgen05CpMulticast::WARPX2_01_23)
5768  ? GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_64x128b_warpx2_01_23, srcFmt, is2CTA)
5769  : GET_TCGEN05_CP_ID(_64x128b_warpx2_02_13, srcFmt, is2CTA);
5770  }
5771  llvm_unreachable("Invalid shape in tcgen05 cp Op");
5772 }

5774 // Returns the valid vector length for a given shape and vector length, the
5775 // function models the table mentioned in the tcgen05.{ld, st} Op description
5776 static unsigned isValidVectorLength(NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape shape,
5777  unsigned vecLen) {
5778  if (shape == NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X128B)
5779  return vecLen >= 2;
5780  if (shape == NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X256B)
5781  return vecLen >= 4;
5782  return true;
5783 }

5785 LogicalResult Tcgen05LdOp::verify() {
5786  LogicalResult result = success();
5787  if (getShape() == NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X32BX2 && !getOffset())
5788  result = emitError("shape 16x32bx2 requires offset argument");
5789 
5790  if (getShape() != NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X32BX2 && getOffset())
5791  result = emitError("offset argument is only supported for shape 16x32bx2");
5792 
5793  auto resTy = getRes().getType();
5794  unsigned resLen = isa<VectorType>(resTy)
5795  ? llvm::cast<VectorType>(resTy).getNumElements()
5796  : 1;
5797  if (!isValidVectorLength(getShape(), resLen))
5798  result = emitError(llvm::formatv("invalid result type length {0} for shape "
5799  "{1} in tcgen05.ld Op",
5800  resLen, stringifyEnum(getShape())));
5801 
5802  return result;
5803 }
5804 
5805 LogicalResult Tcgen05StOp::verify() {
5806  LogicalResult result = success();
5807  if (getShape() == NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X32BX2 && !getOffset())
5808  result = emitError("shape 16x32bx2 requires offset argument");
5809 
5810  auto valTy = getVal().getType();
5811  unsigned valLen = isa<VectorType>(valTy)
5812  ? llvm::cast<VectorType>(valTy).getNumElements()
5813  : 1;
5814  if (!isValidVectorLength(getShape(), valLen))
5815  result = emitError(llvm::formatv("invalid input length {0} for shape "
5816  "{1} in tcgen05.st Op",
5817  valLen, stringifyEnum(getShape())));
5818 
5819  return result;
5820 }

5822 /// Infer the result ranges for the NVVM SpecialRangeableRegisterOp that might
5823 /// have ConstantRangeAttr.
5824 static void nvvmInferResultRanges(std::optional<LLVM::ConstantRangeAttr> range,
5825  Value result,
5826  ArrayRef<::mlir::ConstantIntRanges> argRanges,
5827  SetIntRangeFn setResultRanges) {
5828  if (range) {
5829  setResultRanges(result, {range->getLower(), range->getUpper(),
5830  range->getLower(), range->getUpper()});
5831  } else {
5832  setResultRanges(result, IntegerValueRange::getMaxRange(result).getValue());
5833  }
5834 }
5835 
5836 /// Verify the range attribute satisfies LLVM ConstantRange constructor
5837 /// requirements for NVVM SpecialRangeableRegisterOp.
5838 static LogicalResult
5839 verifyConstantRangeAttr(Operation *op,
5840  std::optional<LLVM::ConstantRangeAttr> rangeAttr) {
5841  if (!rangeAttr)
5842  return success();
5843 
5844  const llvm::APInt &lower = rangeAttr->getLower();
5845  const llvm::APInt &upper = rangeAttr->getUpper();
5846 
5847  // Check LLVM ConstantRange constructor condition
5848  if (lower == upper && !lower.isMaxValue() && !lower.isMinValue()) {
5849  unsigned bitWidth = lower.getBitWidth();
5850  llvm::APInt minVal = llvm::APInt::getMinValue(bitWidth);
5851  llvm::APInt maxVal = llvm::APInt::getMaxValue(bitWidth);
5852  return op->emitOpError(
5853  "invalid range attribute: Lower == Upper, but they aren't min (")
5854  << llvm::toString(minVal, 10, false) << ") or max ("
5855  << llvm::toString(maxVal, 10, false)
5856  << ") value! This is an invalid constant range.";
5857  }
5858 
5859  return success();
5860 }

5883  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_idp4a_s_u,
5884  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_idp4a_s_s,

5904  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_idp2a_u_s,

5917 NVVM::IDArgPair
5918 PrefetchOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(NVVM::PrefetchOp &op,
5919  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
5920  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
5921  using MemSpace = NVVM::NVVMMemorySpace;
5922  using CacheLevel = NVVM::PrefetchCacheLevel;
5923 
5924  std::optional<NVVM::PrefetchCacheLevel> cacheLevel = op.getCacheLevel();
5925  std::optional<NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority> evictPriority =
5926  op.getEvictPriority();
5927  unsigned addressSpace =
5928  llvm::cast<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(op.getAddr().getType())
5929  .getAddressSpace();
5930 
5931  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
5932  llvm::Value *addr = mt.lookupValue(op.getAddr());
5933  args.push_back(op.getInParamSpace() ? getParamCastedAddr(addr, builder)
5934  : addr);
5935 
5936  if (op.getTensormap())
5937  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_tensormap, args};
5938 
5939  assert(cacheLevel && "expected cache level for non-tensormap prefetch");
5940 
5941  if (op.getUniform() && *cacheLevel == CacheLevel::L1)
5942  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetchu_L1, args};
5943 
5944  if (evictPriority && *cacheLevel == CacheLevel::L2) {
5945  switch (*evictPriority) {
5946  case NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority::EvictLast:
5947  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_global_L2_evict_last, args};
5948  case NVVM::CacheEvictionPriority::EvictNormal:
5949  return {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_global_L2_evict_normal, args};
5950  default:
5951  llvm_unreachable("Invalid cache eviction priority");
5952  }
5953  }
5954 
5955  switch (static_cast<MemSpace>(addressSpace)) {
5956  case MemSpace::Generic:
5957  return *cacheLevel == CacheLevel::L1
5958  ? NVVM::IDArgPair({llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_L1, args})
5959  : NVVM::IDArgPair({llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_L2, args});
5960  case MemSpace::Global:
5961  return *cacheLevel == CacheLevel::L1
5962  ? NVVM::IDArgPair(
5963  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_global_L1, args})
5964  : NVVM::IDArgPair(
5965  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_global_L2, args});
5966  case MemSpace::Local:
5967  return *cacheLevel == CacheLevel::L1
5968  ? NVVM::IDArgPair(
5969  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_local_L1, args})
5970  : NVVM::IDArgPair(
5971  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_prefetch_local_L2, args});
5972  default:
5973  llvm_unreachable("Invalid pointer address space");
5974  }
5975 }

5977 bool NVVM::InlinePtxOp::getAsmValues(
5978  RewriterBase &rewriter,
5979  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<std::pair<mlir::Value, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod>>
5980  &asmValues) {
5981  for (auto arg : getReadWriteArgs())
5982  asmValues.push_back({arg, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::ReadWrite});
5983  for (auto arg : getResults())
5984  asmValues.push_back({arg, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Write});
5985  for (auto arg : getReadOnlyArgs())
5986  asmValues.push_back({arg, mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
5987  if (getPredicate())
5988  asmValues.push_back({getPredicate(), mlir::NVVM::PTXRegisterMod::Read});
5989  return false; // No manual mapping needed
5990 }

6008 NVVM::IDArgPair ClusterLaunchControlQueryCancelOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(

6062 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair TensormapReplaceOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
6063  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
6064  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::TensormapReplaceOp>(op);
6065

6068  if (thisOp.getOrd())
6069  args.push_back(builder.getInt32(thisOp.getOrd().value()));
6070  if (thisOp.getNewValue())
6071  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getNewValue()));
6072  if (auto attr = thisOp.getNewValueAttr()) {
6073  auto val =
6074  llvm::TypeSwitch<mlir::Attribute, unsigned>(*attr)
6075  .Case<TensormapElemtypeAttr, TensormapInterleaveLayoutAttr,
6076  TensormapSwizzleModeAttr, TensormapSwizzleAtomicityAttr,
6077  TensormapFillModeAttr>([](auto attr) {
6078  return static_cast<unsigned>(attr.getValue());
6079  })
6080  .Default([](auto attr) {
6081  llvm_unreachable("Invalid attribute type");
6082  return 0;
6083  });
6084  args.push_back(builder.getInt32(val));
6085  }
6086 
6087  static constexpr llvm::Intrinsic::ID IDs[] = {
6088  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_global_address,
6089  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_rank,
6090  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_box_dim,
6091  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_global_dim,
6092  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_global_stride,
6093  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_element_stride,
6094  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_elemtype,
6095  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_interleave_layout,
6096  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_swizzle_mode,
6097  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_swizzle_atomicity,
6098  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tensormap_replace_fill_mode,
6099  };
6100 
6101  unsigned fieldIndex = static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getField());
6102 
6103  return {IDs[fieldIndex], args};
6104 }

6110 static llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind
6111 getNVVMTcgen05MMAKind(NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind kind) {
6112  switch (kind) {
6113  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::F16:
6114  return llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind::F16;
6115  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::TF32:
6116  return llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind::TF32;
6117  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::F8F6F4:
6118  return llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind::F8F6F4;
6119  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::I8:
6120  return llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind::I8;
6121  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::TI16:
6122  return llvm::nvvm::Tcgen05MMAKind::TI16;
6123  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF8F6F4:
6124  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4:
6125  case NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4NVF4:
6126  // Block-scale kinds are handled by the tcgen05.mma.block_scale
6127  // lowering paths and are not valid for plain tcgen05.mma.
6128  llvm_unreachable("Unsupported tcgen05.mma kind");
6129  }
6130 }

6132 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair
6133 Tcgen05MMAOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt,
6134  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
6135 
6136  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::Tcgen05MMAOp>(op);
6137  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
6138 
6139  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixD()));
6140 
6141  llvm::Value *A = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixA());
6142  const bool isATensor = isa<llvm::PointerType>(A->getType());
6143  args.push_back(A);
6144 
6145  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixB()));
6146  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getIdesc()));
6147  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getEnableInputD()));
6148 
6149  using EnableAShiftArray = std::array<llvm::Intrinsic::ID, 2>;
6150  using CtaGroupArray = std::array<EnableAShiftArray, 2>;
6151  using IsATensorArray = std::array<CtaGroupArray, 2>;
6152  using HasScaleInputDArray = std::array<IsATensorArray, 2>;
6153  using HasDisableOutputLaneArray = std::array<HasScaleInputDArray, 2>;
6154 
6155  // [hasDisableOutputLane][hasScaleInputD][isATensor][CtaGroup][EnableAShift]
6156  static constexpr HasDisableOutputLaneArray tcgen05MMAIDs = {
6157  { // without diable output lane
6158  {{// without scale input D
6159  {{
6160  // shared
6161  {{// cg1
6162  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared, notIntrinsic},
6163  // cg2
6164  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared, notIntrinsic}}},
6165  {{// tensor
6166  {
6167  // cg1
6168  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor,
6169  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_ashift,
6170  },
6171  {
6172  // cg2
6173  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor,
6174  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_ashift,
6175  }}},
6176  }},
6177  // with scale input D
6178  {{ // shared
6179  {{// cg1
6180  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_scale_d, notIntrinsic},
6181  // cg2
6182  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_scale_d, notIntrinsic}}},
6183  {{// tensor
6184  {
6185  // cg1
6186  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d,
6187  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_ashift,
6188  },
6189  {
6190  // cg2
6191  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d,
6192  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_ashift,
6193  }}}}}}},
6194  // with disable output lane
6195  {{ // without scale input D
6196  {{ // shared
6197  {{// cg1
6198  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_disable_output_lane_cg1,
6199  notIntrinsic},
6200  // cg2
6201  {llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_disable_output_lane_cg2,
6202  notIntrinsic}}},
6203  {{// cg1
6204  {
6205  llvm::Intrinsic::
6206  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_disable_output_lane_cg1,
6207  llvm::Intrinsic::
6208  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_disable_output_lane_cg1_ashift,
6209  },
6210  // cg2
6211  {
6212  llvm::Intrinsic::
6213  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_disable_output_lane_cg2,
6214  llvm::Intrinsic::
6215  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_disable_output_lane_cg2_ashift,
6216  }}}}},
6217  // with scale input D
6218  {{ // shared
6219  {{// cg1
6220  {llvm::Intrinsic::
6221  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg1,
6222  notIntrinsic},
6223  // cg2
6224  {llvm::Intrinsic::
6225  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg2,
6226  notIntrinsic}}},
6227  // tensor
6228  {{// cg1
6229  {llvm::Intrinsic::
6230  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg1,
6231  llvm::Intrinsic::
6232  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg1_ashift},
6233  // cg2
6234  {
6235  llvm::Intrinsic::
6236  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg2,
6237  llvm::Intrinsic::
6238  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_scale_d_disable_output_lane_cg2_ashift,
6239  }}}}}}}}};
6240 
6241  llvm::Value *ScaleInputD = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getScaleInputD());
6242  bool hasScaleInputD = ScaleInputD != nullptr;
6243 
6244  llvm::Value *DisableOutputLane =
6245  mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDisableOutputLane());
6246  bool hasDisableOutputLane = DisableOutputLane != nullptr;
6247 
6248  const unsigned ctaGroup =
6249  static_cast<unsigned>(getNVVMCtaGroupKind(thisOp.getCtaGroup()));
6250 
6251  llvm::Intrinsic::ID ID =
6252  tcgen05MMAIDs[hasDisableOutputLane][hasScaleInputD][isATensor]
6253  [ctaGroup - 1][thisOp.getAShift()];
6254 
6255  assert(ID != notIntrinsic && "Invalid intrinsic for Tcgen05MMAOp.");
6256 
6257  if (hasScaleInputD)
6258  args.push_back(ScaleInputD);
6259 
6260  if (hasDisableOutputLane)
6261  args.push_back(DisableOutputLane);
6262 
6263  args.push_back(builder.getInt32(
6264  static_cast<unsigned>(getNVVMTcgen05MMAKind(thisOp.getKind()))));
6265 
6266  if (!hasDisableOutputLane)
6267  args.push_back(builder.getInt32(ctaGroup));
6268 
6269  args.push_back(
6270  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOp())));
6271 
6272  args.push_back(
6273  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOpB())));
6274 
6275  return {ID, args};
6276 }
6277 
6278 static LogicalResult
6279 verifyTcgen05MMAOp(bool isATensor, mlir::Value disableOutputLane,
6280  NVVM::CTAGroupKind ctaGroup, bool hasAShift,
6281  NVVM::Tcgen05MMACollectorOp collectorOp, Location loc) {
6282 
6283  if (disableOutputLane) {
6284  mlir::VectorType disableOutputLaneType =
6285  cast<mlir::VectorType>(disableOutputLane.getType());
6286  if ((ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_1 &&
6287  disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements() != 4) ||
6288  (ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_2 &&
6289  disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements() != 8))
6290  return emitError(loc) << "Disable Output Lane of length "
6291  << disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements()
6292  << " is incompatible with CtaGroupAttr";
6293  }
6294 
6295  if (hasAShift && !isATensor)
6296  return emitError(
6297  loc, "A-shift can be applied only when matrix A is in tensor memory");
6298 
6299  if (hasAShift == true && (collectorOp == Tcgen05MMACollectorOp::FILL ||
6300  collectorOp == Tcgen05MMACollectorOp::USE))
6301  return emitError(
6302  loc, "Cannot use collector buffer operation fill or use with ashift");
6303 
6304  return success();
6305 }
6306 
6307 LogicalResult Tcgen05MMAOp::verify() {
6308  return verifyTcgen05MMAOp(isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(getMatrixA().getType()),
6309  getDisableOutputLane(), getCtaGroup(), getAShift(),
6310  getCollectorOp(), getLoc());
6311 }
