6495  static_cast<unsigned>(getNVVMCtaGroupKind(thisOp.getCtaGroup()))));
6496  args.push_back(
6497  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOp())));
6498  args.push_back(
6499  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOpB())));
6500 
6501  auto kind = thisOp.getKind();
6502  auto blockScale = thisOp.getBlockScale();
6503  llvm::Intrinsic::ID ID = [&]() {
6504  if (kind == NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF8F6F4) {
6505  if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::DEFAULT) {
6506  return isATensor ? llvm::Intrinsic::
6507  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf8f6f4_block_scale
6508  : llvm::Intrinsic::
6509  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf8f6f4_block_scale;
6510  } else if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::BLOCK32) {
6511  return isATensor
6512  ? llvm::Intrinsic::
6513  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf8f6f4_block_scale_block32
6514  : llvm::Intrinsic::
6515  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf8f6f4_block_scale_block32;
6516  }
6517  } else if (kind == NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4) {
6518  if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::DEFAULT) {
6519  return isATensor
6520  ? llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf4_block_scale
6521  : llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf4_block_scale;
6522  } else if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::BLOCK32) {
6523  return isATensor ? llvm::Intrinsic::
6524  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf4_block_scale_block32
6525  : llvm::Intrinsic::
6526  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf4_block_scale_block32;
6527  }
6528  } else if (kind == NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4NVF4) {
6529  if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::BLOCK32) {
6530  return isATensor
6531  ? llvm::Intrinsic::
6532  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf4nvf4_block_scale_block32
6533  : llvm::Intrinsic::
6534  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf4nvf4_block_scale_block32;
6535 
6536  } else if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::BLOCK16) {
6537  return isATensor
6538  ? llvm::Intrinsic::
6539  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_mxf4nvf4_block_scale_block16
6540  : llvm::Intrinsic::
6541  nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_mxf4nvf4_block_scale_block16;
6542  }
6543  }
6544  llvm_unreachable("Invalid tcgen05.mma.block_scale attributes");
6545  }();
6546 
6547  return {ID, args};
6548 }
6549 
6550 static LogicalResult verifyTcgen05MMABlockScaleOp(
6551  NVVM::Tcgen05MMACollectorOp collectorOp, NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind kind,
6552  NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale blockScale, Location loc) {
6553  if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::DEFAULT &&
6554  kind == NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4NVF4)
6555  return emitError(loc, "mxf4nvf4 requires block scale attribute");
6556 
6557  if (blockScale == NVVM::Tcgen05MMABlockScale::BLOCK16 &&
6558  kind != NVVM::Tcgen05MMAKind::MXF4NVF4)
6559  return emitError(loc,
6560  llvm::formatv("{} kind does not support block16 attribute",
6561  stringifyEnum(kind)));
6562 
6563  return success();
6564 }

6742 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair Tcgen05MMADecompressBOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
6743  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
6744  auto thisOp = cast<Tcgen05MMADecompressBOp>(op);
6745  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
6746 
6747  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixD()));
6748 
6749  llvm::Value *A = mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixA());
6750  const bool isATensor = isa<llvm::PointerType>(A->getType());
6751  args.push_back(A);
6752 
6753  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getMatrixB()));
6754  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getIdesc()));
6755  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getEnableInputD()));
6756  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDecompressBMetadata()));
6757 
6758  llvm::Value *DisableOutputLane =
6759  mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getDisableOutputLane());
6760  bool hasDisableOutputLane = DisableOutputLane != nullptr;
6761 
6762  NVVM::CTAGroupKind ctaGroup = thisOp.getCtaGroup();
6763 
6764  using namespace llvm::Intrinsic;
6765  ID intrinsicID = not_intrinsic;
6766 
6767  if (hasDisableOutputLane) {
6768  if (ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_1) {
6769  intrinsicID =
6770  isATensor
6771  ? nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_f8f6f4_disable_output_lane_cg1_decompress_b
6772  : nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_f8f6f4_disable_output_lane_cg1_decompress_b;
6773  } else if (ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_2) {
6774  intrinsicID =
6775  isATensor
6776  ? nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_f8f6f4_disable_output_lane_cg2_decompress_b
6777  : nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_f8f6f4_disable_output_lane_cg2_decompress_b;
6778  } else {
6779  llvm_unreachable("Unknown ctaGroup for tcgen05.mma.decompress_b");
6780  }
6781  } else {
6782  intrinsicID = isATensor ? nvvm_tcgen05_mma_tensor_f8f6f4_decompress_b
6783  : nvvm_tcgen05_mma_shared_f8f6f4_decompress_b;
6784  }
6785 
6786  assert(intrinsicID != not_intrinsic &&
6787  "Invalid intrinsic for Tcgen05MMADecompressBOp.");
6788 
6789  if (hasDisableOutputLane)
6790  args.push_back(DisableOutputLane);
6791  else
6792  args.push_back(
6793  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(getNVVMCtaGroupKind(ctaGroup))));
6794 
6795  args.push_back(
6796  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOpA())));
6797  args.push_back(
6798  builder.getInt32(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getCollectorOpB())));
6799 
6800  return {intrinsicID, args};
6801 }
6802 
6803 LogicalResult Tcgen05MMADecompressBOp::verify() {
6804  mlir::Value disableOutputLane = getDisableOutputLane();
6805 
6806  if (disableOutputLane) {
6807  NVVM::CTAGroupKind ctaGroup = getCtaGroup();
6808 
6809  mlir::VectorType disableOutputLaneType =
6810  cast<mlir::VectorType>(disableOutputLane.getType());
6811  if ((ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_1 &&
6812  disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements() != 4) ||
6813  (ctaGroup == NVVM::CTAGroupKind::CTA_2 &&
6814  disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements() != 8))
6815  return emitOpError() << "Disable Output Lane of length "
6816  << disableOutputLaneType.getNumElements()
6817  << " is incompatible with CtaGroupAttr";
6818  }
6819 
6820  return success();
6821 }

6862 // NVVM tcgen05.ld.red functions
6863 //===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
6864 
6865 #define TCGEN05LDRED(SHAPE, NUM, TYPE) \
6866  llvm::Intrinsic::nvvm_tcgen05_ld_red_##SHAPE##_##NUM##_##TYPE
6867 
6868 mlir::NVVM::IDArgPair NVVM::Tcgen05LdRedOp::getIntrinsicIDAndArgs(
6869  Operation &op, LLVM::ModuleTranslation &mt, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
6870  auto thisOp = cast<NVVM::Tcgen05LdRedOp>(op);
6871  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> args;
6872 
6873  mlir::VectorType VecResTy =
6874  cast<mlir::VectorType>(thisOp.getData().getType());
6875  unsigned Num = VecResTy.getNumElements();
6876  bool IsFloat = thisOp.getRedVal().getType().isF32();
6877 
6878  llvm::Intrinsic::ID Shape32x32b[][2] = {
6879  {notIntrinsic, notIntrinsic},
6880  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x2, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x2, f32)},
6881  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x4, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x4, f32)},
6882  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x8, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x8, f32)},
6883  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x16, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x16, f32)},
6884  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x32, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x32, f32)},
6885  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x64, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x64, f32)},
6886  {TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x128, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(32x32b, x128, f32)},
6887  };
6888 
6889  llvm::Intrinsic::ID Shape16x32bx2[][2] = {
6890  {notIntrinsic, notIntrinsic},
6891  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x2, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x2, f32)},
6892  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x4, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x4, f32)},
6893  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x8, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x8, f32)},
6894  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x16, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x16, f32)},
6895  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x32, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x32, f32)},
6896  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x64, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x64, f32)},
6897  {TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x128, i32), TCGEN05LDRED(16x32bx2, x128, f32)},
6898  };
6899 
6900  NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape shape = thisOp.getShape();
6901  unsigned ID = [&]() {
6902  // `num` contains the length of vector and log2 of `num` returns the index
6903  // into the shape array
6904  unsigned idx = std::log2(Num);
6905  switch (shape) {
6906  case NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_32X32B:
6907  return Shape32x32b[idx][IsFloat];
6908  case NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X32BX2:
6909  return Shape16x32bx2[idx][IsFloat];
6910  default:
6911  llvm_unreachable("unhandled tcgen05.ld lowering");
6912  }
6913  }();
6914 
6915  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getAddr()));
6916 
6917  if (shape == NVVM::Tcgen05LdStShape::SHAPE_16X32BX2)
6918  args.push_back(mt.lookupValue(thisOp.getOffset()));
6919 
6920  args.push_back(
6921  builder.getInt32(thisOp.getOp() == NVVM::ReductionKind::MIN ? 0 : 1));
6922 
6923  if (IsFloat) {
6924  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getAbs())));
6925  args.push_back(builder.getInt1(static_cast<unsigned>(thisOp.getNan())));
6926  }
6927  return {ID, args};
6928 }
6929 
6930 LogicalResult Tcgen05LdRedOp::verify() {
6931  VectorType data = cast<VectorType>(getData().getType());
6932  Type redVal = getRedVal().getType();
6933 
6934  if (data.getElementType() != redVal)
6935  return emitError(
6936  "type of reduction value and element type of vector data should match");
6937 
6938  if (getOp() != NVVM::ReductionKind::MIN &&
6939  getOp() != NVVM::ReductionKind::MAX)
6940  return emitError("only min and max reduction kinds are supported");
6941 
6942  if (redVal.isInteger() && (getAbs() || getNan())) {
6943  return emitError("abs or nan is only applicable for f32 type");
6944  }
6945  return success();
6946 }

6980 LogicalResult NVVMDialect::verifyOperationAttribute(Operation *op,
6981  NamedAttribute attr) {
6982  StringAttr attrName = attr.getName();
6983  // Kernel function attribute should be attached to functions.
6984  if (attrName == NVVMDialect::getKernelFuncAttrName()) {
6985  if (!isa<LLVM::LLVMFuncOp>(op)) {
6986  return op->emitError() << "'" << NVVMDialect::getKernelFuncAttrName()
6987  << "' attribute attached to unexpected op";
6988  }
6989  }
6990  // If maxntid / reqntid / cluster_dim exist, it must be an array with max 3
6991  // dim
6992  if (attrName == NVVMDialect::getMaxntidAttrName() ||
6993  attrName == NVVMDialect::getReqntidAttrName() ||
6994  attrName == NVVMDialect::getClusterDimAttrName()) {
6995  auto values = llvm::dyn_cast<DenseI32ArrayAttr>(attr.getValue());
6996  if (!values || values.empty() || values.size() > 3) {
6997  return op->emitError()
6998  << "'" << attrName
6999  << "' attribute must be integer array with maximum 3 index";
7000  }
7001  }
7002  // If minctasm / maxnreg / cluster_max_blocks exist, it must be an integer
7003  // attribute
7004  if (attrName == NVVMDialect::getMinctasmAttrName() ||
7005  attrName == NVVMDialect::getMaxnregAttrName() ||
7006  attrName == NVVMDialect::getClusterMaxBlocksAttrName()) {
7007  if (!llvm::dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(attr.getValue())) {
7008  return op->emitError()
7009  << "'" << attrName << "' attribute must be integer constant";
7010  }
7011  }
7012  // blocksareclusters must be used along with reqntid and cluster_dim
7013  if (attrName == NVVMDialect::getBlocksAreClustersAttrName()) {
7014  if (!op->hasDiscardableAttr(NVVMDialect::getReqntidAttrName()) ||
7015  !op->hasDiscardableAttr(NVVMDialect::getClusterDimAttrName())) {
7016  return op->emitError()
7017  << "'" << attrName << "' attribute must be used along with " << "'"
7018  << NVVMDialect::getReqntidAttrName() << "' and " << "'"
7019  << NVVMDialect::getClusterDimAttrName() << "'";
7020  }
7021  }
7022 
7023  return success();
7024 }
7025 
7026 LogicalResult NVVMDialect::verifyRegionArgAttribute(Operation *op,
7027  unsigned regionIndex,
7028  unsigned argIndex,
7029  NamedAttribute argAttr) {
7030  auto funcOp = dyn_cast<FunctionOpInterface>(op);
7031  if (!funcOp)
7032  return success();
7033 
7034  bool isKernel = op->hasDiscardableAttr(NVVMDialect::getKernelFuncAttrName());
7035  StringAttr attrName = argAttr.getName();
7036  if (attrName == NVVM::NVVMDialect::getGridConstantAttrName()) {
7037  if (!isKernel) {
7038  return op->emitError()
7039  << "'" << attrName
7040  << "' attribute must be present only on kernel arguments";
7041  }
7042  if (!isa<UnitAttr>(argAttr.getValue()))
7043  return op->emitError() << "'" << attrName << "' must be a unit attribute";
7044  if (!funcOp.getArgAttr(argIndex, LLVM::LLVMDialect::getByValAttrName())) {
7045  return op->emitError()
7046  << "'" << attrName
7047  << "' attribute requires the argument to also have attribute '"
7048  << LLVM::LLVMDialect::getByValAttrName() << "'";
7049  }
7050  }
7051 
7052  return success();
7053 }

7118 LogicalResult
7119 NVVMTargetAttr::verify(function_ref<InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError,
7120  int optLevel, StringRef triple, StringRef chip,
7121  StringRef features, DictionaryAttr flags,
7122  ArrayAttr files, bool verifyTarget) {
7123  if (optLevel < 0 || optLevel > 3) {
7124  emitError() << "The optimization level must be a number between 0 and 3.";
7125  return failure();
7126  }
7127  if (triple.empty()) {
7128  emitError() << "The target triple cannot be empty.";
7129  return failure();
7130  }
7131  if (chip.empty()) {
7132  emitError() << "The target chip cannot be empty.";
7133  return failure();
7134  }
7135  if (files && !llvm::all_of(files, [](::mlir::Attribute attr) {
7136  return mlir::isa_and_nonnull<StringAttr>(attr);
7137  })) {
7138  emitError() << "All the elements in the `link` array must be strings.";
7139  return failure();
7140  }
7141  return success();
7142 }
7143 
7144 LogicalResult NVVMTargetAttr::verifyTarget(Operation *gpuModule) {
7145  if (!getVerifyTarget())
7146  return success();
7147 
7148  auto gpuModuleOp = llvm::dyn_cast<gpu::GPUModuleOp>(gpuModule);
7149  if (!gpuModuleOp) {
7150  return emitError(gpuModule->getLoc(),
7151  "NVVM target attribute must be attached to a GPU module");
7152  }
7153 
7154  const unsigned targetFullSmVersion =
7155  NVVMCheckSMVersion::getTargetFullSmVersionFromStr(getChip());
7156  if (!NVVMCheckSMVersion::isMinimumSMVersion(targetFullSmVersion)) {
7157  return emitError(gpuModule->getLoc(),
7158  "Minimum NVVM target SM version is sm_20");
7159  }
7160 
7161  if (gpuModuleOp
7162  ->walk([&](Operation *op) {
7163  if (auto reqOp = llvm::dyn_cast<NVVM::RequiresSMInterface>(op)) {
7164  const NVVMCheckSMVersion requirement =
7165  reqOp.getRequiredMinSMVersion();
7166  if (!requirement.isCompatibleWith(targetFullSmVersion)) {
7167  op->emitOpError() << "is not supported on " << getChip();
7168  return WalkResult::interrupt();
7169  }
7170  }
7171  return WalkResult::advance();
7172  })
7173  .wasInterrupted())
7174  return failure();
7175 
7176  return success();
7177 }
